rows.title: Research Analyst - Data Center & Infrastructure
rows.descriptionText:
Who we are:
The company is a management consulting firm, founded to offer clients a more engaged and hands-on experience. Our partner-led, team-based approach allows us to advise clients on their most challenging business issues such as how to enter new markets, analyze their current competitive and portfolio positions, defend share, and reorganize more profitably. Our solutions are backed by market data and practical, achievable recommendations. We support clients across a broad set of markets in industry sectors such as industrials, aerospace, healthcare , technology, and consumer.

Data Center Analyst opportunity:
Our Industrials practice area is rapidly growing as the data center, power infrastructure, and electrical infrastructure ecosystem become some of the most consequential and fast-moving sectors in the economy today. The volume of client demand in this space has created an opportunity to create a new, data center-focused Analyst role to own that expertise.This is not a traditional consulting track. There is no expectation of business development or people management responsibilities. What there is: a long-term platform to become the most knowledgeable person in the room and in the market – in a sector that matters and in the context of real client problems.
The right person will build and maintain a living knowledge base of the ecosystem, including contributing to a global market model we can leverage across projects, conduct primary research, serve as a resident expert across project teams, and generate external- facing thought leadership.The work our analysts do is the foundation upon which all our recommendations are built. You will make an impact as a contributing member of a project team in your first few weeks of work. Our training and development program is hands-on from day one, and will help you build the foundational skill set needed to drive results for our clients. We integrate ongoing development opportunities into our project delivery process so that your learning never ends with us.

Data Center Analyst responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain deep expertise across the data center, power, and electrical infrastructure ecosystem.• Conduct primary research: expert interviews, vendor and customer diligence, ecosystem mapping, and synthesis of fragmented market information.• Support multiple BCE project teams simultaneously as a resident sector expert,• Build a durable, internal knowledge base that compounds over time and contributes to a global market model• Translate technical and market complexity into clear, structured analysis & deliverables• Track emerging developments across sectors such as AI infrastructure, hyperscaler strategy, colocation markets, power demand trends, cooling technology, electrical equipment supply chains, power generation and utility infrastructure markets, and contribute to thought leadership in this space.

You’re a strong fit if:
• You have 2-3 years of experience in equity research, market modeling, market intelligence, infrastructure investing, expert networks, or a strategy/analytics role.• You’ve spent meaningful time on data centers, power infrastructure, electrical equipment, utilities, or adjacent markets and find it genuinely interesting, not just professionally convenient.• You’re known for being thorough, synthesizing fragmented information, and building clear points of view from primary research.• You’d rather go deeper into one domain than manage people or build a client book.• You are energized as an individual contributor and see specialist depth as a benefit.• You have built primary source relationships in this space: experts, operators, investors, or vendors you can call to get to the truth quickly.

Qualifications:
• 2-3 years of relevant professional experience as outlined above.• Demonstrated ability to conduct and synthesize primary research under tight deadlines.• Demonstrated experience with building a market model.• Strong written communication skills and ability to produce structured, clear analysis that non- specialists can act on.• Genuine intellectual curiosity about the data center and power infrastructure ecosystem• Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across different project teams
Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Location: Boston, MAHours: 8:00-6:00pm
Employee Value Proposition:
From day one at us, you’ll own meaningful work, gain direct exposure to clients and firm leadership, and grow into a leader faster than you thought possible. You’ll be surrounded by smart, supportive colleagues who are as caring as they are driven. We’ll invest in you with a competitive compensation package, which includes a 401k match, profit sharing, full health coverage, unlimited PTO, MBA sponsorship opportunities, and the potential for international exposure and experience.The work is demanding, but the payoff is accelerated growth, shared success, and a skillset that will benefit you far beyond the company.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
Our CommitmentAt Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

rows.title: Analyst II, Casino Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As an Analyst II, Casino Analytics, you'll turn data into decisive action that strengthens our operations and fuels smarter decision-making. You'll partner across teams to evaluate workflows, uncover emerging trends, and build reporting infrastructure that keeps our business running at scale. In this role, you'll translate complex analyses into clear insights that shape strategy, improve efficiency, and support high-impact initiatives across evolving products and markets. Your work will drive visibility, scalability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What you'll do

Transform complex, large-scale datasets into strategic insights that shape business decisions and unlock sustainable growth across the organization.Translate sophisticated analyses into clear, compelling narratives that influence stakeholders at multiple levels and drive alignment on key priorities.Lead the design, execution, and analysis of experiments, proactively identifying opportunities to accelerate learning and optimize performance.Partner with cross-functional teams to refine strategic initiatives, improve performance across channels, and drive measurable business outcomes.Build, automate, and continuously improve scalable reporting frameworks and dashboards that empower teams to make faster, data-driven decisions.


What you'll bring

Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.At least 2 years of analytics or data science experience.Familiarity with programming languages such as SQL, Python, R, SAS, or Matlab.Strong understanding of statistics and hypothesis testing; experience building models is a plus.Ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights for diverse audiences.Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a demonstrated ability to uncover new insights from data.


Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is 78,400.00 USD - 98,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

rows.title: Market Access Operations Analyst, Global Rare Diseases
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Based in Parma, Italy, Chiesi is an international research-focused biopharmaceutical group with 90 years’ experience, operating in 31 countries. More than 8,000 employees across the group are united by a singular purpose: promoting a healthier world for our people, patients, and the planet. This is what drives us as we research, develop, and market innovative drugs across our main therapeutic areas. Discover more here.

At Chiesi we are thinking generations ahead, driving sustainable innovation with purpose. This fosters a culture of reliability, transparency, and ethical behaviour at every level. As a Benefit Corporation and a certified B Corp, we have embedded sustainability in our bylaws and continuously measure our impact.

Diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity are at the heart of who we are. We believe our differences make us stronger. We are a vibrant ecosystem of passionate, talented individuals united by strong values, each bringing unique perspectives that help us to continuously challenge the status quo for the better.

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases is a Chiesi Group’s business unit established in February 2020 and focused on research, development and commercialization of treatments and patient support services for rare and ultra-rare disorders, many of whom have limited or no treatments available.

This unit is based in Boston, Massachusetts, with a strong synergy with the headquarters in Parma.

Rare unit has a focus on research and product development for lysosomal storage diseases, rare hematology, ophthalmology disorders and rare immunodeficiencies. The unit is also a dedicated partner with global leaders in scientific research, patient advocacy and care. Discover more here.

Who We Are Looking For

This is what you will do

Reporting to the Head, Pricing, Contracting and Forecasting, Americas Market Access Rare Diseases, the Market Access Operations Analyst will work with Market Access data and access, specifically for Chiesi Global Rare Disease products for the Americas.

This role’s main responsibility is Market Access metrics and reporting as it relates to Trade and Specialty Pharmacy agreements.

You’ll be responsible for:

The Market Access Operations Analyst position contributes to company success by being a key role to create and analyze Market Access data reporting and trends. This role will also be critical in executing data related tasks for the Market access team, and project management related functions. This role will support the Market Access team as needs arise, focusing on price trends, copay card utilization, distribution channel data needs, and payer invoice review.

This role will need to remain up to date on legislative policies and measure impact to GRD portfolio.

Analyzing and regularly updating complex data sets (payer mix, competitive market data etc.)Organize and cross check discounts with Finance and Government pricingBuild and update policy forecast trackers with financial inputsSupport Market Access policy and contracting needsPricing analyses and reimbursement trackingLead for Market Access vendors and user access


The Market Access Operations Analyst role with work cross functionally with multiple functions such as Marketing, Patient Services, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR), Finance, Business Knowledge, Sales, New Product Planning and other departments. It will also work closely with third-party service providers.

You will need to have

BS/BA required.1-2 years experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry in data analytics type roles.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize data and deliver a clear overview of Market Access insights.Strong analytical (qualitative and quantitative), strategic thinking, creativity & problem-solving skills.Self-directed and confident, with ability to contribute to shared commitment and goals to achieve high standards of performance.Ability to successfully manage multiple tasks and multifunctional resources concurrently while maintaining high attention to detail while responding to rapidly changing priorities and aggressive deadlines.Proficient in SQL and MS Office, specifically Excel. 


We would prefer for you to have

Advanced degree.Knowledge of current US payer environment and Market Access dynamics.Additional experience working with analysis or other data reporting tools (such as PowerBI).


Location

Hybrid role based in Boston, MA.

Compensation

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $107,190 to $131,010. Hourly and salaried non-exempt employees will also be paid overtime pay when working qualifying overtime hours. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. If hired, the employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. 

What We Offer

No matter where your path starts at Chiesi, it leads to inspiring possibilities. Your future is our focus, and we are committed to nurturing your development in our dynamic, friendly environment with access to resources and training every step of the way.

We provide top-class benefits, including comprehensive healthcare programs, work-life balance initiatives, and robust relocation support. Our salary package is competitive, comprising a basic salary, performance bonuses, and benefits benchmarked against the external market. Additionally, we offer flexible working arrangements, remote work options, and tax assistance services for foreign colleagues, all designed to help you thrive.

Chiesi USA is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse work force at all levels of our business. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. This policy applies with regard to all aspects of one’s employment, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits and termination.

rows.title: Data Warehouse Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join our team and experience how we lead with passion, positivity, and accountability to deliver the Right Talent. Right Now. We create an environment where you can think big, have fun and truly make a difference.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Data Warehouse Analyst to support and evolve our enterprise data warehouse environment. This role is split between daily operational responsibilities that ensure the reliability and performance of our data platform, and project-based initiatives focused on enhancing data models, pipelines, and analytical capabilities.

Education

 Master’s degree in Astronomy, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related discipline. 

Domain Knowledge

Experience with standard astronomical data analysis and reduction procedures.  Strong mathematical foundation, with experience applying statistical methods to scientific data. Description

Catholic Charities of Baltimore is seeking an Enterprise Systems and Data Analyst to support the effective use of enterprise applications, data, and reporting tools to improve operations and decision-making. This role bridges business needs and technology solutions, ensuring systems and data practices are reliable, practical, and aligned with Agency priorities. The position strengthens workflows, supports accurate information, and helps stakeholders use technology effectively to advance service delivery and the Agency’s mission.

Partners with Agency leaders and stakeholders to identify business needs, define priorities, and translate operational objectives into comprehensive requirements that support effective system solutions, reporting, and service delivery.Elicits, documents, validates, and communicates requirements through interviews, document analysis, workshops, surveys, site visits, use cases, scenarios, and workflow analysis to ensure solutions accurately reflect business processes and user needs.Analyzes business processes, data, and system functionality to recommend practical improvements that increase efficiency, strengthen reporting accuracy, and maximize the value of Agency technology investments.Supports project plans and executes by identifying milestones, phases, dependencies, risks, and action steps; tracking progress; communicating updates; resolving barriers; and recommending corrective actions when needed.Develops technical reports and dashboards by collecting, analyzing, validating, and summarizing information in collaboration with program administrators and other stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, useful, and aligned with operational needs.Performs other duties as assigned to support Agency operations, technology initiatives, and continuous improvement priorities.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Data Science, Information Systems Management and Technology, or relatable discipline.Two (2) years of related experience in a business analysis and/or business intelligence capacity, including all aspects of process, including data analysis, databases (SQL Server), business intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.), data mapping, metrics optimization and report creation.

Required Skills & Abilities

Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to evaluate complex information, identify patterns, and recommend practical solutions that support business and technology decisions.Advanced technical proficiency with Microsoft 365, Excel, Power BI, PowerAutomate, Power Platform, Teams, SharePoint, and related web-based applications, with the ability to quickly learn and apply new systems and tools.Clear, concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information, document requirements, and share insights accurately with business, technical, and leadership audiences.Collaborative interpersonal style, with the ability to build effective working relationships with staff, senior management, clients, visitors, and vendors while demonstrating courtesy, professionalism, and respect for diverse perspectives.High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly when analyzing data, documenting requirements, validating reports, and supporting decisions that rely on reliable information.Self-directed and flexible work style, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively, meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing Agency needs.Sound judgment and professionalism, with the ability to act with discretion, tact, and integrity when handling sensitive information, competing priorities, and varied stakeholder needs.Dependable and accountable, with consistent attendance, punctuality, and follow-through that support reliable service delivery and team effectiveness.

Single-Family Data Analyst

At Freddie Mac, you will do important work to build a better housing finance system, and you’ll be part of a team helping to make homeownership and rental housing more accessible and affordable across the nation.

We are accepting applications for this position until 10/16/2026

Position Overview:

The Single-Family division within Freddie Mac is searching for creative individuals to join our organization. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong foundation in statistical analysis, quantitative problem solving, and data-driven decision making. Successful candidates will demonstrate curiosity, strong communication skills, and an eagerness to learn how emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, can enhance business outcomes.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to organize ideas clearly and explain analytical findings effectively.Solid foundation in statistical analysis, quantitative problem solving, data analysis, and data-driven methodologies.Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.Self-driven, curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in a fast-paced environment.

rows.descriptionText:
Our client, a global investment management organization, is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Alternative Investments Solutions - Data Strategy team. This hands-on role combines data analytics, reporting, process optimization, and automation to drive data-driven decision-making.

The analyst will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Management to maintain critical Alts reporting, build dashboards and data workflows, improve data quality, and transform investment data into actionable insights that help drive sales strategy and business growth. The ideal candidate is a proactive, growth-oriented problem solver who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats while helping build scalable solutions.

Job Title: Data Analyst II

Location: Baltimore, MD or New York, NY

Pay Range: $38/hr - $42/hr

Contract: 12-Months

What's the Job?

Build, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad-hoc reports supporting trade lifecycle, transaction status, sales performance, reconciliations, and business operations. Write SQL and Python scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, and automation. Develop, support, and optimize ETL workflows, pipelines, and data integrations. Create dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools to deliver actionable business insights. Automate manual reporting, data preparation, validation, notification, and exception-management processes. Monitor data quality, troubleshoot production issues, and implement solutions that enhance reporting reliability and performance. Partner with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, support releases, and deliver reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives. Leverage AI-assisted development practices to increase efficiency, optimization, and solution quality. 


What's Needed?

Bachelor’s degree in analytics, computer science, information systems, engineering, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data operations; experience within financial services, asset management, or alternative investments is a plus. Strong SQL and Python skills. Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and cloud or relational databases. Proficiency in creating dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data quality. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders. Demonstrated ownership and ability to manage multiple priorities. 


Preferred Skills:

Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Git, APIs, or workflow orchestration tools. Familiarity with sales, CRM, transaction, advisor, or product data. Experience with reporting automation and AI-assisted development tools. 


What's in it for me?

Opportunity to work on impactful data and automation projects within a growing alternative investments business. Exposure to investment distribution, sales intelligence, and data engineering. Collaborate with experienced professionals in a dynamic environment. Develop scalable workflows and improve data quality and reporting efficiency. Potential for professional growth and skill enhancement in a forward-thinking organization.

rows.title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Position Description

GEICO is seeking an experienced software engineer to work on our Infrastructure Automation Tools team to help drive our tech transformation from a traditional IT model to one focused on engineering excellence, good code and documentation hygine, and creating resilient architectures driven by automation. This team is focused on automated tools and infrastructure as code to streamline operations on our Openstack private cloud, our network, and our hardware fleet. Managing a private cloud in an enterprise environment requires knowledge of hardware, virtualization, operating systems, and infrastructure automation.

Position Responsibilities

As An Infrastructure Automation Engineer, You Will

Drive innovation of OS and firmware update strategies to ensure good testing, stability, performance, security, and remote management capabilities Develop tools and processes for automated testing of servers and operating system images Develop tools to monitor server fleet health and performance, focusing on strategic upgrades, proactive maintenance, and quick response to hardware, firmware, and detecting anomalies Devise and implement automation scripts and tools for a wide range of fleet management tasks using a combination of IaC (Ansible, Terraform, etc) and traditional programming languages like Python, Go, and Rust Work closely with our Openstack, Storage (ceph), and Hybrid Cloud teams to understand the automation needs for managing our private cloud, and understand the potential impact of OS and Firmware updates Develop hardware lifecycle strategies, assessing ongoing performance, cost-effectiveness, and longevity from procurement to decommissioning Keep a finger on the pulse of industry innovations, especially concerning CPU, chipset, storage, GPU, firmware, and BMC developments, ready to lead adaptation and advancement within our infrastructure 

Desired Experience And Qualifications

Professional development experience in one or more of: Python, Go, Rust, C Familiarity with IaC tools such as Ansible and Terraform in an enterprise private cloud environment Hands-on experience in OS and firmware management strategies in a private cloud environment Hands-on experience in systems/server management working with technologies like Redfish, BMC, and IPMI standards and crafting solutions for enhanced remote management of server hardware Familiarity with architecture and management of server hardware, particularly focusing on CPU, chipset, storage, and GPU integration, and interoperability standards Understanding of OpenStack and proven success in elevating server fleet management and automation practices Experience implementing logging and dashboards with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki Exceptional problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and meticulous attention to integration details Industry certifications that endorse expertise in hardware engineering, firmware management, or data center operations are highly beneficial Understanding of Active Directory, Windows Authentication, SAML, OAuth  

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent education or work experience

$75,000.00 - $215,000.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

rows.title: Network Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Number: 26-01267

Use your skills where innovative technology solutions begin. ECLARO is looking for a Network Engineer for our client in Columbia, MD. 

ECLARO’s client is a leading technology solutions provider, collaborating with customers to manage their needs and achieve success in their business goals. If you’re up to the challenge, then take a chance at this rewarding opportunity!

Position Overview:

Seeking a motivated Network Engineer with a strong networking foundation and CCNA-level knowledge to support a variety of network infrastructure projects within a large enterprise environment. This individual will work under the guidance of a Senior CCIE-Level Engineer, assisting with network upgrades, switch deployments, and Meraki camera initiatives across multiple locations. This is an excellent opportunity for an Engineer looking to gain hands-on experience supporting enterprise networking projects while expanding their technical skills alongside experienced network architects. This is an implementation-focused role—not a network design position. 

Responsibilities:

Perform Layer 2 access switch replacements and network hardware refreshes. Configure and deploy Cisco switches and perform basic router configurations. Support network upgrade projects, including planned cutovers and migrations. Assist with the deployment and support of Meraki camera infrastructure. Troubleshoot network connectivity issues and respond to outage-related support requests. Provide hands-on support for wireless access points when needed, escalating to senior engineers for advanced troubleshooting. Verify network connectivity following installations and upgrades. Work closely with a CCIE-level engineer on implementation activities and project execution. Document completed work and communicate project status to the team. 

Required Qualifications:

CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge. Experience configuring Cisco switches in an enterprise environment. Understanding of Layer 2 / Layer 3 networking fundamentals. Solid knowledge of VLANs and network segmentation. Understanding of how VoIP phones connect and communicate across a network. Experience supporting network cutovers, hardware replacements, or infrastructure upgrades. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Experience:

Experience with Cisco Meraki products. Basic understanding of wireless networking concepts, including access points, SSIDs, RF fundamentals, and wireless troubleshooting. Experience supporting Meraki wireless or camera deployments. Exposure to Cisco router configuration. Firewall administration is not required. Should be comfortable performing hands-on network installations, upgrades, and troubleshooting while collaborating with senior engineering resources. Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are essential for success in this role. 

If hired, you will enjoy the following ECLARO Benefits:

401k Retirement Savings Plan administered by Merrill LynchCommuter Check Pretax Commuter BenefitsEligibility to purchase Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance through ECLARO

LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

The Associate Data Center Hardware Engineer is a hands-on technical role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of LinkedIn's global infrastructure. This position is responsible for executing hardware break-fix activities, providing advanced troubleshooting support, and serving as an escalation point for contracted data center technicians. In addition to performing direct repair work, the role partners with vendors, mentors contract staff, and drives consistency in service delivery across all LinkedIn data center operations.

Perform break-fix repairs, including but not limited to replacing failed drives, DIMMs, fans, power supplies, and other server or network hardware components. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated issues from contracted technicians, applying diagnostics and escalating unresolved issues to Data Center Hardware Engineers or LinkedIn engineering teams as needed. Participate in onboarding new contracted data center technicians, including training on daily operational tasks. Serve as a technical mentor for contracted data center technicians, providing training and guidance to improve quality and consistency. Participate in an on-call rotation to support global data center operations. 

Qualifications

1+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role1+ years of Linux troubleshooting experience1+ years of server hardware troubleshooting experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry experience. 2+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role2+ years Linux troubleshooting experience. 2+ years server hardware troubleshooting experience.

Hardware Deployment & InstallationProject ManagementTicketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow)Linux/UnixServer and Network Troubleshooting

rows.title: Digital Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
A Fortune 500 investment firm is seeking a Digital Product Analyst to help improve digital customer experiences through data-informed insights. The analyst will partner with product, analytics, technology, and business teams to evaluate customer journeys, measure product performance, and identify opportunities for improvement.
The ideal candidate combines hands-on analytical skills with strong business judgment. This person can move beyond routine reporting to investigate open-ended questions, recognize meaningful behavioral patterns, and translate complex findings into clear recommendations that support product decisions.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Analytics and InsightsAnalyze digital customer behavior and product performance using web analytics and event-level data.Evaluate funnels, paths, segments, and trends to identify friction, abandonment, unexpected behavior, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.Define meaningful measures of success for product features and assess outcomes after release.Develop clear, evidence-based recommendations that help product teams prioritize improvements.Investigation and AnalysisTranslate business and product questions into structured analytical approaches.Use SQL and analytical tools to extract, validate, combine, and interpret data from multiple sources.Investigate changes in customer behavior and product performance, recognizing patterns and potential contributing factors.Document assumptions, data limitations, and the evidence supporting conclusions.Measurement and CollaborationPartner with product and business stakeholders to define key performance indicators, measurement plans, and analytical questions.Collaborate with analytics and technology partners to validate findings, resolve data-quality concerns, and improve measurement.Communicate findings through concise analysis, visualizations, and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences.Maintain recurring performance reporting and support minor updates to established dashboards as business needs evolve.Product Delivery SupportUse analytical evidence to support product priorities, enhancements, and trade-off decisions.Help define expected outcomes and measurement needs for planned work.Support release evaluation and confirm that appropriate measures are available to assess results.Participate in product planning and Agile delivery activities as an analytical partner.Required QualificationsBachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.2–3 years of experience in product analytics, digital analytics, business analysis, customer experience analytics, or a related field.Strong SQL skills for data extraction, analysis, and troubleshooting.Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, or similar web analytics platforms.Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, and manipulation.Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business and product recommendations.Demonstrated ability to independently investigate open-ended business or product questions using multiple data sources and communicate evidence-based conclusions.
Preferred QualificationsExperience applying funnel, path, segmentation, conversion, or abandonment analysis to digital customer journeys.Strong collaboration, organization, and communication skills.Experience analyzing complex digital customer journeys in financial services, cybersecurity, identity, or another regulated environment.Experience with a cloud data platform.Experience validating digital analytics instrumentation or defining measurement requirements.Working knowledge of Power BI, including maintaining or making minor enhancements to an established dashboard.Experience with experimentation, usability research, customer-feedback analysis, or statistical methods.Experience supporting Agile or Scrum product teams.

rows.title: Marketing Operations Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

The Marketing Operations Coordinator supports the execution, and operational workflows of multi-channel customer relationship management initiatives. With a focus on email and push notification marketing, this role will support the current Marketing Manager and will partner together in building, testing, and deploying campaigns within the Braze platform to enhance user engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Braze Campaign Execution: Build and deploy, one-time, triggered, and automated campaigns, including email, push notifications, in-app messages and design and execute a/b tests.Customer Journey Orchestration: Set up and maintain user journeys in Braze Canvas, configuring segments, filters, and behavioral triggers to ensure the right audience receives the right message at the right time.Data & Personalization: Leverage Liquid Logic (templating) and Connected Content in Braze to create highly personalized dynamic content.Quality Assurance (QA): Serve as the final, meticulous check on campaign setups, including link validation, segmentation accuracy, push payload testing, and proper rendering across email clients.Campaign Scheduling & Reporting: Manage a campaign calendar, ensuring timely delivery. Monitor campaign KPIs (open rates, click-through rates, conversions) and build reporting with insights.Own day-to-day monitoring and management of data interfaces between Braze, and Amplitude, Snowflake, other marketing platforms that are interfacing with Braze and alert appropriate teams of any issues.

Required Skills And Experience

At least 2 years hands on experience in email/push CRM or Lifecycle marketing operations.Hands-on experience with Braze specifically with building Campaigns, Canvas, and Segmentation.Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously, and the ability to identify data discrepancies/inconsistencies and communicate effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with other MARTECH tools (Amplitude, Tableau, Snowflake).Ability to troubleshoot campaign issues, data errors, and user segmentation issues. Knowledge of email/push best practices. 

Pay Range

$31.25—$33.65 USD

Benefits

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

 Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. rows.title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Position Description

GEICO is seeking an experienced software engineer to work on our Infrastructure Automation Tools team to help drive our tech transformation from a traditional IT model to one focused on engineering excellence, good code and documentation hygine, and creating resilient architectures driven by automation. This team is focused on automated tools and infrastructure as code to streamline operations on our Openstack private cloud, our network, and our hardware fleet. Managing a private cloud in an enterprise environment requires knowledge of hardware, virtualization, operating systems, and infrastructure automation.

Position Responsibilities

As An Infrastructure Automation Engineer, You Will

Drive innovation of OS and firmware update strategies to ensure good testing, stability, performance, security, and remote management capabilities Develop tools and processes for automated testing of servers and operating system images Develop tools to monitor server fleet health and performance, focusing on strategic upgrades, proactive maintenance, and quick response to hardware, firmware, and detecting anomalies Devise and implement automation scripts and tools for a wide range of fleet management tasks using a combination of IaC (Ansible, Terraform, etc) and traditional programming languages like Python, Go, and Rust Work closely with our Openstack, Storage (ceph), and Hybrid Cloud teams to understand the automation needs for managing our private cloud, and understand the potential impact of OS and Firmware updates Develop hardware lifecycle strategies, assessing ongoing performance, cost-effectiveness, and longevity from procurement to decommissioning Keep a finger on the pulse of industry innovations, especially concerning CPU, chipset, storage, GPU, firmware, and BMC developments, ready to lead adaptation and advancement within our infrastructure 

Desired Experience And Qualifications

Professional development experience in one or more of: Python, Go, Rust, C Familiarity with IaC tools such as Ansible and Terraform in an enterprise private cloud environment Hands-on experience in OS and firmware management strategies in a private cloud environment Hands-on experience in systems/server management working with technologies like Redfish, BMC, and IPMI standards and crafting solutions for enhanced remote management of server hardware Familiarity with architecture and management of server hardware, particularly focusing on CPU, chipset, storage, and GPU integration, and interoperability standards Understanding of OpenStack and proven success in elevating server fleet management and automation practices Experience implementing logging and dashboards with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki Exceptional problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and meticulous attention to integration details Industry certifications that endorse expertise in hardware engineering, firmware management, or data center operations are highly beneficial Understanding of Active Directory, Windows Authentication, SAML, OAuth  

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent education or work experience 

Annual Salary

$75,000.00 - $215,000.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Our client, a global investment management organization, is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Alternative Investments Solutions - Data Strategy team. This hands-on role combines data analytics, reporting, process optimization, and automation to drive data-driven decision-making.

The analyst will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Management to maintain critical Alts reporting, build dashboards and data workflows, improve data quality, and transform investment data into actionable insights that help drive sales strategy and business growth. The ideal candidate is a proactive, growth-oriented problem solver who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats while helping build scalable solutions.

Job Title: Data Analyst II

Location: Baltimore, MD or New York, NY

Pay Range: $38/hr - $42/hr

What's the Job?

Build, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad-hoc reports supporting trade lifecycle, transaction status, sales performance, reconciliations, and business operations. Write SQL and Python scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, and automation. Develop, support, and optimize ETL workflows, pipelines, and data integrations. Create dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools to deliver actionable business insights. Automate manual reporting, data preparation, validation, notification, and exception-management processes. Monitor data quality, troubleshoot production issues, and implement solutions that enhance reporting reliability and performance. Partner with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, support releases, and deliver reporting, analytics, and automation initiatives. Leverage AI-assisted development practices to increase efficiency, optimization, and solution quality. 


What's Needed?

Bachelor’s degree in analytics, computer science, information systems, engineering, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data operations; experience within financial services, asset management, or alternative investments is a plus. Strong SQL and Python skills. Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and cloud or relational databases. Proficiency in creating dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data quality. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders. Demonstrated ownership and ability to manage multiple priorities. 


Preferred Skills:

Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Git, APIs, or workflow orchestration tools. Familiarity with sales, CRM, transaction, advisor, or product data. Experience with reporting automation and AI-assisted development tools. 


What's in it for me?

Opportunity to work on impactful data and automation projects within a growing alternative investments business. Exposure to investment distribution, sales intelligence, and data engineering. Collaborate with experienced professionals in a dynamic environment. Develop scalable workflows and improve data quality and reporting efficiency. Potential for professional growth and skill enhancement in a forward-thinking organization.

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Card Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:

rows.descriptionText:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

The Associate Data Center Hardware Engineer is a hands-on technical role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of LinkedIn's global infrastructure. This position is responsible for executing hardware break-fix activities, providing advanced troubleshooting support, and serving as an escalation point for contracted data center technicians. In addition to performing direct repair work, the role partners with vendors, mentors contract staff, and drives consistency in service delivery across all LinkedIn data center operations.

Responsibilities:

Perform break-fix repairs, including but not limited to replacing failed drives, DIMMs, fans, power supplies, and other server or network hardware components. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated issues from contracted technicians, applying diagnostics and escalating unresolved issues to Data Center Hardware Engineers or LinkedIn engineering teams as needed. Instal new SSD's and NVME's into existing servers. Conduct basic Linux OS and IPMI-level troubleshooting across all server platformsAssist LinkedIn engineers with troubleshooting and resolving autobuild (Linux Kickstart) failures, including - straggler- nodes. Diagnose and resolve physical-layer network connectivity issues. Execute hardware installations and repairs outside the scope of planned quarterly organic growth projects. Actively monitor and engage with the Jira ticket queue, ensuring proper ticket handling and quality resolution by contracted data center technicians. Participate in onboarding new contracted data center technicians, including training on daily operational tasks. Serve as a technical mentor for contracted data center technicians, providing training and guidance to improve quality and consistency. Participate in an on-call rotation to support global data center operations.

1+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role1+ years of Linux troubleshooting experience1+ years of server hardware troubleshooting experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry experience. 2+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role2+ years Linux troubleshooting experience. 2+ years server hardware troubleshooting experience.

Hardware Deployment & InstallationProject ManagementTicketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow)Linux/UnixServer and Network Troubleshooting

The Opportunity

As a Transfer Pricing Associate, you will engage in navigating the complexities of global tax regulations, optimizing intercompany pricing to align with value creation and tax efficiency. Within our Tax practice, you will contribute to designing and implementing effective international tax structures, reinforcing compliance with cross-border regulations. This role offers the chance to work closely with clients, helping them optimize their tax strategies and seize opportunities for sustainable growth.

As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagements, developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to build meaningful connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, embrace ambiguity, ask questions, and use these challenges as opportunities for growth.

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic environment where you will support senior staff, engage in research, and participate in project tasks. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.

Responsibilities

 Conducting financial modeling and analysis to support transfer pricing strategies Navigating transfer pricing regulations to optimize intercompany pricing and align with tax efficiency Engaging in tax research to provide accurate and up-to-date information and advice Collaborating with teams to design and implement effective international tax structures Analyzing financial statements to assess the health and performance of business operations Participating in client support tasks to enhance compliance and minimize risks Utilizing intellectual curiosity to explore innovative solutions in the global tax landscape Translating economic data to inform strategic decision-making and value creation

What You Must Have

 Currently pursuing or have completed a Bachelor's degree in one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Economics, Finance At least a 3.0 overall GPA Client service associate positions are entry-level roles and job seekers have completed or are in the process of completing their final academic year of educational requirements

What Sets You Apart

 Preference for a 3.5 overall GPA Leveraging AI to create efficiencies, innovate ways of working and deliver distinctive outcomes Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn Utilizing financial modeling and statement analysis skills Navigating transfer pricing regulations effectively Engaging in tax research to provide accurate insights Excelling in teamwork and client support tasks

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The Card DS team is working continuously to innovate the way we handle data to transform every corner of our business through analytics, infrastructure, valuations, and strategy. We build human-centric experiences for moments that matter throughout the customer journey, and we do this by harnessing data, technology, and talent to propel our business forward. To accomplish this goal, we design, build, and maintain the appropriate solutions we use across Card to make smart, informed decisions. We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build predictive models and utilize the advantages of large-scale data and cloud-based processing. Through these techniques, we extract relevant insights from data to tackle a huge variety of business problems.

In this role you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal candidate will be:

Curious and creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions, and you love pushing hard to find the answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. Technical: You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions from concept to production using open source tools and modern cloud computing platforms. You are not afraid of petabytes of data. Statistically-minded. You have built models, validated them and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series analysis and deep learning. Customer and product oriented. You share our passion for changing banking for good.

We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

We are looking for a dynamic, analytical, detail-oriented, and collaborative consultant to support the preparation of projects in the water, sanitation, and solid waste sector. The consultant will also contribute to the identification and application of artificial intelligence and other digital tools to improve operational processes, data analysis, knowledge management, and project preparation.

You will work in Water, Sanitation and Solid Waste Division (WSA), part of the Infrastructure and Energy (INE) Sector. This team is responsible for conceptualizing, preparing, supporting the execution of IDB’s operations related to water, sanitation, and solid waste.

What You’ll Do

Support the preparation of loans, technical cooperations, and other operational instruments through the approval process.Identify and apply artificial intelligence (AI) and other digital tools to improve project preparation, document review, data analysis, knowledge management, and internal processes.Support AI-enabled solutions, including data analysis, information classification, document summarization, process automation, and the preparation of analytical outputs.Ensure compliance with applicable policies and alignment between project activities, operating plans, and established timelines.Update operational information and documentation in Convergence and other relevant systems.Propose innovative and efficient approaches to improve internal processes.Perform other duties required to support the effective delivery of the Division’s operational services.

What You'll Need

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, economics, water and/or sanitation subjects, or other fields relevant to the responsibilities of the role. Experience: At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in project preparation, project management, data analysis, digital transformation, or related activities. Knowledge in water, sanitation, solid waste, or development sectors, as well as AI tools, is desirable.Languages: Proficiency in English and Spanish, spoken and written, is required.

Requirements

Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents. Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

International consultant Full-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility). 

What We Offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee’s life. These benefits include:

A competitive compensation package.Leaves and vacations: 2 days per month of contract + gender-neutral parental leave.Health Insurance: The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance to supplement the purchase of health insurance.Savings plan: The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance.We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.On-site position with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more.Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees.Other office amenities (as available): Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, spouse career support, and others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

Job Description

The Database Engineer will manage and optimize database systems for client data storage infrastructure. The engineer will implement and maintain different data stores, ensure database performance and reliability, and work with data engineers to integrate databases into data pipelines. The engineer will design and implement database schemas and structures, establish database backup and recovery procedures, and optimize database performance through indexing, query optimization, and configuration tuning. The engineer will implement database security controls and access management, monitor database health and resource utilization, and troubleshoot complex database issues. The engineer will manage database version upgrades and patches, implement database high availability and disaster recovery solutions, and automate routine database administration tasks. The engineer will evaluate new database technologies for potential adoption, maintain database documentation, and provide database expertise to development teams. The engineer will develop and enforce database standards and best practices, conduct capacity planning for database growth, and implement database monitoring and alerting systems.

Responsibilities include designing, developing, testing, maintaining, migrating, securing, monitoring, and optimizing database solutions using Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, PostgreSQL and PL/pgSQL, Amazon RDS for Oracle, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS), AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT), Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), and related AWS capabilities.

Experience managing and optimizing databases in complex environmentsDemonstrated expertise in database design, performance tuning, backup/recovery, security, and/or integration with data pipelines

Hands-on expertise with Oracle and PostgreSQL database solutions and AWS database services, tools, and components.

rows.title: Sr. Data Scientist (Forecasting)
rows.descriptionText:
As the digital arm for the world's largest food and beverage company, Nestlé IT & Digital Americas harnesses the power of data, analytics, and innovative technology to deliver transformative solutions and business resiliency for Nestlé businesses and iconic brands from Purina® to Nescafé®. We’re innovators, strategic collaborators, value multipliers, and digital business leaders committed to delivering results that create meaningful experiences and drive value, enabling Nestlé to win in the marketplace. This shared unity and purpose is what motivates individuals to join, stay, and advance their careers within Nestlé.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Summary

Join Nestlé IT & Digital as a Sr. Data Scientist supporting Nestlé USA Digital, where you'll partner with the Supply Chain Planning team and the Analytics team to build the forecasting solutions that power how Nestlé USA plans and operates at scale. You'll design and deploy production-grade forecasting models, embed AI into how forecasts get delivered, and serve as a key liaison between the technical and functional sides of Enterprise Forecasting. You'll bring a strong AI mindset, curiosity about emerging technologies, and comfort operating in ambiguity as the forecasting landscape evolves.

Design, develop, test, and deploy statistical and machine learning forecasting models in production on cloud-based analytics platforms, with a focus on demand pattern recognition, algorithm selection, outlier correction, and parameter optimization to drive forecast accuracy and bias reduction Build and maintain structured, programmatic forecasting processes that deliver at scale, leveraging ML Ops practices to automate weekly forecast generation and reduce manual effort Embed Agentic AI and GenAI capabilities into forecasting workflows to identify accuracy improvement opportunities, automate root cause analysis, and support insights generation and decision-making Continuously explore and apply emerging AI/ML techniques such as deep learning and probabilistic forecasting to improve forecast accuracy and scalability across a complex portfolio of SKUs, clusters, and data sources Serve as a liaison between technical and functional teams, partnering with Supply Chain Planning leads and cross-functional stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, and Sales to align business needs with system and process solutions Advance Enterprise Forecasting as part of the One Planning initiative and support Customer Order Fulfilment improvements, enabling standardized, scalable, and cross-functional forecasting solutions across the organization Deliver training and forecast office hours to Supply Chain Planning users to build analytics literacy, promote adoption, and increase enterprise value Create and enhance Power BI reports for forecast KPI monitoring and data validation, and present findings through data visualization and PowerPoint tailored to the audience 

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, business, or a related field 5+ years of experience in data science, forecasting, or advanced analytics, with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, or a similar language 5+ years of experience extracting, transforming, and analyzing large datasets, and creating data visualizations to communicate insights 3+ years of experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production, including regression, classification, time series modeling, and feature engineering 

Other

Master's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, business, or a related discipline is preferred Experience with ML Ops practices, cloud and AI/ML platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Azure), GenAI solutions, and Microsoft Power BI is preferred Experience supporting enterprise-scale transformation or Supply Chain planning initiatives in an Agile environment is preferred
