rows.title: 2027 PhD Graduate - Space Algorithms and Technologies
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Are you interested in changing science fiction into reality for our national security in space?

Are you passionate about learning about the latest technologies or algorithms and finding new ways to use them?

Do you want to work with brilliant colleagues on challenging problems while still having work-life balance?

If so, we're looking for someone like you on our team at APL!

If you are graduating with a PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computational Sciences or a related technical field, we'd love to have you join our team!

We are seeking a driven engineer, mathematician, or scientist to help us continue designing, developing and assessing the various space technologies and algorithms. You'll be joining a hardworking team who balances independent work and team work on a variety of space-based projects. Our group maintains proficiencies in photonics, signatures, advanced technology applications, orbital engagements, space control concept assessment, autonomous operations, and multi-disciplinary optimization.

As a member of the APL team, your duties could include:

 Researching, designing, developing, and testing space components Characterizing the performance of current, proposed and future space systems, sensors (EO/IR, radar, etc.) and constellations. Developing algorithms to improve and assess performance of space systems.

Our staff come from a set of technical backgrounds and heavily leverage programming skills (e.g. C, C++, Matlab, Python) and modeling skills (e.g. Systems Tool Kit, Astrogator, PTC Creo). We also run a photonics lab where we develop sensor hardware for spacecraft payloads. We hire from many disciplines including engineering, physics, astronomy, applied mathematics, and computer science.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

Have a PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computational Sciences or a related technical fieldAre an expert in an area of research that can be applied to technologies or algorithms related to space control applicationsAre willing and able to occasionally travel to sponsor locationsAre able to obtain Interim Top Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have experience adapting new technologies or algorithms to space-based applicationsHave prior work experience in the space industryHave an active TS/SCI clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. This team is focused on automated tools and infrastructure as code to streamline operations on our Openstack private cloud, our network, and our hardware fleet. Managing a private cloud in an enterprise environment requires knowledge of hardware, virtualization, operating systems, and infrastructure automation.

We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

The Associate Data Center Hardware Engineer is a hands-on technical role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of LinkedIn's global infrastructure. This position is responsible for executing hardware break-fix activities, providing advanced troubleshooting support, and serving as an escalation point for contracted data center technicians. In addition to performing direct repair work, the role partners with vendors, mentors contract staff, and drives consistency in service delivery across all LinkedIn data center operations.

Responsibilities:

Perform break-fix repairs, including but not limited to replacing failed drives, DIMMs, fans, power supplies, and other server or network hardware components. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated issues from contracted technicians, applying diagnostics and escalating unresolved issues to Data Center Hardware Engineers or LinkedIn engineering teams as needed. Instal new SSD's and NVME's into existing servers. Conduct basic Linux OS and IPMI-level troubleshooting across all server platformsAssist LinkedIn engineers with troubleshooting and resolving autobuild (Linux Kickstart) failures, including - straggler- nodes. Diagnose and resolve physical-layer network connectivity issues. Execute hardware installations and repairs outside the scope of planned quarterly organic growth projects. Actively monitor and engage with the Jira ticket queue, ensuring proper ticket handling and quality resolution by contracted data center technicians. Participate in onboarding new contracted data center technicians, including training on daily operational tasks. Serve as a technical mentor for contracted data center technicians, providing training and guidance to improve quality and consistency. Participate in an on-call rotation to support global data center operations. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

1+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role1+ years of Linux troubleshooting experience1+ years of server hardware troubleshooting experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry experience. 2+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role2+ years Linux troubleshooting experience. 2+ years server hardware troubleshooting experience. 

Suggested Skills:

Hardware Deployment & InstallationProject ManagementTicketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow)Linux/UnixServer and Network Troubleshooting

rows.title: 2027 Internship - AI and Autonomous Systems Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Are you interested in working in multi-disciplinary teams to advance the state-of-the-art in autonomous systems, uncrewed air platforms, artificial intelligence, software design, embedded systems, virtual reality, and simulation?

Are you interested in applying your skills to conceive, design, prototype and test new capabilities in intelligent autonomous systems that will save US warfighter’s lives and ensure our nation’s preeminence?

If you are pursuing a degree in Math, Computer Science, Physics, and/or Engineering or related area with a background in Software Development, and you answered “yes” to either of these questions, we are looking for someone like you to join our team in the Intelligent Combat Platforms Group at APL!

Who are we?

We are the Intelligent Combat Platforms Group, and our mission focus is to ensure our Nation maintains the operational advantage on the future battlefield through foundational advances in artificial intelligence, autonomy, manned-unmanned teaming and novel unmanned aircraft (e.g., drones) design and testing. We believe the future of warfare will be defined by intelligent autonomous systems capable of fighting with machine precision at machine speeds. Whether it is developing the intelligence that drives autonomous wingmen behaviors, integrated real-time collaboration tools and data analytic architectures, or novel AI design tools and software, the Intelligent Combat Platforms Group is at the forefront. Three of our recent game-changing projects (DARPA Air Combat Evolution, AFRL Golden Horde, and Air Force SkyBorg) are featured in recent news articles, highlighting our impact and innovation.

We are seeking inquisitive and creative team members who like to tackle challenging problems to help us build the next generation of autonomous combat systems and shape the future of warfare. Our team is an entrepreneurial and multidisciplinary team committed to developing technical talent, cultivating a culture of innovation and collaboration, while having fun with what we do!

As a member of our team, possible roles include…

Work on collaborative teams in one or more areas: software/hardware design, flight system test and evaluation, and next generation autonomous air platforms.Prototype and simulate AI and autonomous systems by writing code, developing software (simulation and visualization), creating algorithms, or interfacing software/hardware.Contribute to all facets of the data-to-deployment lifecycle of machine learning models.

Collaborate with the nation’s leading experts in intelligent combat systems and work with a team of engineers, scientists, and software developers to deliver impactful capability to the warfighter.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

Are pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in a STEM (Math, Computer Science, Physics, and/or Engineering or related area) field.Have classroom or professional experience working with our core skills: autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, deep/reinforcement/machine learning, robotics, dynamics and controls, flight test and evaluation, modeling and simulation, aerodynamics, air combat platform design, data science, and statistical analysis.Strong communication skills and can work and collaborate effectively in a team environment.Have a minimum 3.0 GPA on a 4.0 scale. Note: When prompted to upload attachments, please include a copy of your college transcripts (unofficial transcripts are acceptable).Are able to obtain an Secret-level security clearance by your start date. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you…

Have proficiency in programming languages and environments (Python, C++, C, C#, Java, Linux Javascript, Terminal, Bash, Pytorch, tensorflow, Unity, MATLAB), full stack development, simulation development, cloud computing, and configuration management.Experience in manufacturing, prototyping, and designing mechanical systems such as machine shop and fabrication with CNC mills and 3D printing. Have experience working with sensors, hardware, or flight test support.Are an uncrewed aerial system (UAS) tinkerer, enthusiast, and hobbyist with piloting experience.Have completed any certifications or internships.Hold an active secret clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

Minimum Rate

$22.60 Hourly

Maximum Rate

$47.95 Hourly

rows.title: Python Developer (AWS, Serverless)
rows.descriptionText: At Peregrine Advisors, you will develop Python applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and take responsibility for the components you deliver. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public.Your first projectYour first project will likely have you taking user stories from refinement through production. Depending on the assignment, you may:Build serverless, event-driven application workflows using AWS Lambda and Step Functions.Integrate commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products with frameworks developed in-house.Build internal and external application programming interface (API) connections.Build data and document pipelines that automate manual, paper-based work.You deliver tested, working code you own through production, including the defects you find and fix. You automate business operations that replace manual checks, validations, and spreadsheet workflows, and you build deployment pipelines that make releasing services routine.This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.Requirements4+ years of software development experienceBachelor's degreeWorking-level command of PythonExperience with modern languages and frameworks, and with version controlFamiliarity with cloud development on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) conceptsAbility to turn a defined specification into working, tested code and own it through to productionBasic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and ExcelPreferredHands-on delivery of production workloads on Amazon Web Services (AWS), or an AWS certificationFederal information technology experienceFamiliarity with AI-assisted developer toolingWho you areYou care about what you build and judge it by whether it works for the people who rely on it. As priorities move, you move with them, and you learn a new tool or domain deeply enough to make judgment calls in it rather than follow instructions. You communicate clearly, adapt across roles and clients, and care about creating public value. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.What you bringA practical command of modern cloud development, with the range to build something new or make an existing system work better.The matching delivery habits, meaning version control, unit and integration testing, code review, secure coding, and accessibility.Plain-language communication about your work with the people who depend on it, explaining clearly and listening for what they need.The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.When we talkBe prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.BenefitsMedical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.What we offerYou will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.What we commit toAs a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

rows.title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Position Description

GEICO is seeking an experienced software engineer to work on our Infrastructure Automation Tools team to help drive our tech transformation from a traditional IT model to one focused on engineering excellence, good code and documentation hygine, and creating resilient architectures driven by automation. This team is focused on automated tools and infrastructure as code to streamline operations on our Openstack private cloud, our network, and our hardware fleet. Managing a private cloud in an enterprise environment requires knowledge of hardware, virtualization, operating systems, and infrastructure automation.

Position Responsibilities

As An Infrastructure Automation Engineer, You Will

Drive innovation of OS and firmware update strategies to ensure good testing, stability, performance, security, and remote management capabilities Develop tools and processes for automated testing of servers and operating system images Develop tools to monitor server fleet health and performance, focusing on strategic upgrades, proactive maintenance, and quick response to hardware, firmware, and detecting anomalies Devise and implement automation scripts and tools for a wide range of fleet management tasks using a combination of IaC (Ansible, Terraform, etc) and traditional programming languages like Python, Go, and Rust Work closely with our Openstack, Storage (ceph), and Hybrid Cloud teams to understand the automation needs for managing our private cloud, and understand the potential impact of OS and Firmware updates Develop hardware lifecycle strategies, assessing ongoing performance, cost-effectiveness, and longevity from procurement to decommissioning Keep a finger on the pulse of industry innovations, especially concerning CPU, chipset, storage, GPU, firmware, and BMC developments, ready to lead adaptation and advancement within our infrastructure 

Desired Experience And Qualifications

Professional development experience in one or more of: Python, Go, Rust, C Familiarity with IaC tools such as Ansible and Terraform in an enterprise private cloud environment Hands-on experience in OS and firmware management strategies in a private cloud environment Hands-on experience in systems/server management working with technologies like Redfish, BMC, and IPMI standards and crafting solutions for enhanced remote management of server hardware Familiarity with architecture and management of server hardware, particularly focusing on CPU, chipset, storage, and GPU integration, and interoperability standards Understanding of OpenStack and proven success in elevating server fleet management and automation practices Experience implementing logging and dashboards with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki Exceptional problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and meticulous attention to integration details Industry certifications that endorse expertise in hardware engineering, firmware management, or data center operations are highly beneficial Understanding of Active Directory, Windows Authentication, SAML, OAuth  

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent education or work experience 

Annual Salary

$75,000.00 - $160,000.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

GEICO will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The GEICO Pledge

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

The equal employment opportunity policy of the GEICO Companies provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

rows.title: Customer Deliver Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Customer Deliver Analyst

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

Team Lead Customer Supply Chain

Location:

North America, United States, Arkansas, Rogers

Work Location:

Hybrid

Key Responsibilities

What you will do

The Customer Deliver Analyst plays a critical role in improving customer experience and supply chain performance through data-driven decision making, digital tools, and cross-functional collaboration. This role partners with a variety of teams to identify risks, solve operational challenges, and implement solutions that improve service, inventory health, logistics efficiency, and overall supply chain performance.

Leveraging analytics, automation, and modern reporting tools, the role supports business planning, forecasting, inventory management, and logistics execution by transforming complex data into actionable insights and recommendations. This position helps identify opportunities, improve decision-making, and drive operational excellence across the supply chain.

Beyond day-to-day operations, the role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing customer satisfaction, improving service levels, reducing costs, and increasing efficiency. Opportunities may include supporting benchmarking activities, evaluating emerging technologies, and participating in projects that strengthen forecasting, replenishment, logistics, reporting, and broader supply chain capabilities.

Primary Functional Responsibilities Can Include

Translate complex data into clear business recommendations, including customer-level, SKU-level, ship-to-level, and network-level insights.Use tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Excel, Power BI, SAP/BW, EDI, Celonis, and other analytics platforms to investigate issues, summarize findings, and support continuous improvement.Collaborate with sales, customer, supply chain, and logistics teams to ensure accurate forecasting, improved logistics efficiency and efficient inventory replenishment.Lead and support process improvement initiatives focused on cost reduction, service level enhancement, and operational efficiency.Prepare and present data-driven recommendations to internal stakeholders and leadership.Use AI-enabled tools, automation, and advanced analytics to identify trends, root causes, service risks, and improvement opportunities across order management, replenishment, inventory, and logistics.Support order execution and exception management by using data, systems, and cross-functional collaboration to resolve service issues, improve process reliability, and reduce recurring manual intervention.Proactively manage order fulfillment to meet customer demand through integration with operating company, distribution, and planning/forecasting.Participate in cross-functional projects focused on supply chain optimization and customer service enhancement.Lead initiatives to standardize reporting formats, templates, and processes across the team and department.Design and maintain dashboards and regular reports for key supply chain metrics (e.g., forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory turns, on-time delivery).Lead short-term Sales & Operations execution alignment across cross-functional teams to ensure responsiveness and agility.Develop and leverage key business relationships to understand the customer expectations and internal policies/capabilities to proactively manage the business to meet customer expectations. Identify, plan and implement end-to-end solutions that improve service, cost, or develop new capabilitiesApply AI and digital tools to simplify recurring analysis, improve reporting speed, reduce manual work, and support faster decision-making.Analyze, recommend, and implement modifications to customer purchasing patterns and Kenvue network for optimal service and improved logistics efficienciesDrive process and systems improvements that positively impact order management, inventory management, and dashboard measuresFind opportunities to develop transportation solutions to improve on-time delivery and drive profitable growth through logistics, replenishment, and policy optimization.Help resolve escalated discrepancies relating to data integrity, shipping issues, and trade pricing/promotional management through root cause identification and corrective actionsMonitor and report critical metrics (in stock/out of stock, fill rate, and on-time delivery), and research root cause with supply chain partners and provide back in stock date and action plans to correct and prevent in the future.Partner with Supply Chain and Sales to provide detail by SKU recommendations to Customer to drive higher inventory during periods experiencing lift (promotional, seasonal, etc.).Support Sales/Demand Planning by providing item level POS and Supply Plan data and feature/ad/promo or reset ship dates.

Required Qualifications

What we are looking for

2-4 years of related work experience required.Solid problem-solving and analytical skills required.Proficiency with MS Office, including advanced Excel required.Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI, etc.) required.University/Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent.

Desired Qualifications

Strong collaboration and communication skills with experience working on multi-functional teams preferred.Experience with developing digital solutions preferred.SAP experience preferred.Demonstrated ability and desire to learn and optimize new systems and applications preferred.A customer-centric mindset, with customer-facing working experience is preferred.Experience working in the End-to-End Supply Chain (Sourcing, Planning, Manufacturing, Transportation, Distribution, Customer Service) is preferred.Business applications preferred, such as BW, EDI, Celonis or other ERP Systems.Process Excellence training or certification such as Lean, Six Sigma is preferred.Strong project management skills are preferred.

What’s In It For You

Annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges:

$72,675.00 - $102,600.00

This takes into account a number of factors including work location, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level & other job-related factors.

Competitive Benefit Package*Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time & More!Learning & Development OpportunitiesKenvuer Impact NetworksThis list could vary based on location/regionNote: Total Rewards at Kenvue include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits. Your Talent Access Partner will be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the recruitment & hiring process.

Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

rows.title: Demand Finance Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

We are Nature’s Bakery, one of the fastest growing snack brands in the category and have recently joined the Mars family of companies, to accelerate the growth of our healthier snacking platform. We have a bright future ahead of us. Come bake with us and create a world of snacking that is both good, and good for you.

The Demand Finance Manager will serve as a strategic finance partner to the Sales and Marketing organizations, providing financial insights and decision support across forecasting, customer and channel performance, marketing investments, innovation, and commercial planning. This role will help connect commercial strategies and demand assumptions to financial outcomes, providing visibility into volume, revenue, trade, margin, and profitability. The Demand Finance Manager will work closely with Sales, Marketing, FP&A, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, and other cross-functional partners to improve forecast accuracy, strengthen financial planning, and support data-driven business decisions.

What are we looking for?

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.5+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Sales Finance, Demand Finance, or related roles, preferably within CPG or a similar industry.Strong understanding of financial statements, forecasting, customer economics, revenue, trade, margin, and profitability.Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with advanced Excel capabilities.Experience partnering with Sales and/or Marketing organizations strongly preferred.Experience supporting forecasting, annual planning, innovation, customer/channel analysis, or commercial business reviews preferred.Familiarity with SAP, Power BI, planning systems, TPM systems, or similar financial and commercial tools preferred.Strong communication and business partnering skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What Will Be Your Key Responsibilities?

Sales & Marketing Finance Partnership:

Serve as a key finance partner to Sales and Marketing, providing financial analysis and insights to support business decisions.Support customer, channel, and brand performance reviews, identifying key drivers, risks, and opportunities versus plan and prior year.Develop financial scenarios to evaluate changes in volume, customer plans, marketing investments, mix, and other commercial assumptions.Provide visibility into the financial impact of Sales and Marketing initiatives across revenue, trade, net sales, margin, and profitability.Partner with commercial teams to identify opportunities to improve financial performance and deliver against business objectives.

Forecasting & Planning:

Support the financial components of the demand and S&OP planning process, ensuring commercial assumptions are appropriately reflected in the financial forecast.Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand and validate volume, customer, channel, innovation, and investment assumptions.Translate demand changes into financial impacts across revenue, trade, net sales, margin, and profitability.Partner with FP&A to support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), periodic forecasts, long-range planning, and business reviews.Analyze forecast versus actual performance and identify key drivers of variance, risks, and opportunities.Help improve forecast accuracy, visibility, and planning processes across the commercial organization.Support the multi-year Integrated Value Creation Plan (IVCP) by developing demand financial models, analyzing volume and gross margin trajectories, and partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to validate key commercial assumptions.

Customer, Channel & Portfolio Performance:

Support customer and channel P&Ls and provide insights into revenue, trade, margin, mix, and profitability performance.Analyze customer and channel trends to identify financial opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.Support Sales with financial modeling for customer plans, business reviews, and commercial opportunities.Evaluate product and customer mix impacts and provide recommendations to support profitable growth.Partner with Trade Finance to ensure trade assumptions and actual spending are appropriately reflected in customer and financial forecasts.

Job Title: VP, Transportation Lead

Function: Transportation

Division: NAFS - Transportation

Location: Cranbury, NJ and Clark, NJ

Reports To: SVP, NAFS 

Who We Are

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At L'Oréal Operations, we create innovative, inclusive, and sustainable beauty together with our business partners by designing, developing, sourcing, manufacturing, and distributing over 6 billion products globally every year. We support over 36 brands across four L’Oréal divisions. We are consumer-oriented, and we act responsibly all along the value chain.  

What You Will Do

 

Are you ready to lead one of the most dynamic, large-scale consumer goods transportation networks in North America?

As the Head of North America Transportation, you will own and transform the end-to-end physical flow of goods. Reporting directly to senior operations leadership within North America Fulfillment Services (NAFS), you will serve as the executive leader bridging day-to-day operational execution (Operate) with strategic capability building, governance, and digital transformation (Build & Adapt / NOE).

Your scope spans the entire value chain: inbound freight from global suppliers into our manufacturing plants, plant-to-distribution center replenishment, and outbound delivery from our DC network to major retail partners, salons, specialty channels, and directly to consumers’ doorsteps.

You will lead the strategy and operational execution across three vital business mandates:

Cost-to-Serve Optimization: Partnering with Indirect Sourcing and commercial divisions to drive structural freight efficiencies, mode conversions (LTL to TL/Intermodal), and payload optimization.Customer Service Excellence: Driving flawless On-Time Pickup (OTPU) and On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance through carrier relationship management and tight integration with our distribution center network.Sustainable Logistics & Decarbonization: Leading the L'Oréal for the Future (L4TF) transportation agenda, implementing green freight initiatives, and meeting aggressive carbon reduction targets while supporting aggressive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End Operational Leadership (Operate)P&L and Financial Stewardship: Manage the North America transportation budget. Drive cost-to-serve reduction initiatives, eliminate operational waste (accessorials, detention, expedited freight), and ensure financial predictability.Network Execution & Performance: Lead domestic operations, international freight forwarding, dedicated fleets, and final-mile delivery across all North American channels (B2B, Retail, Specialty, and D2C).Service Delivery: Maintain top-tier SLA compliance, focusing on On-Time Pickup (OTPU), On-Time Delivery (OTD), carrier capacity commitments, and retailer compliance chargeback minimization.Carrier Strategy & Sourcing Alignment: In close partnership with Indirect Sourcing, drive strategic carrier allocation, master service agreements, rate negotiations, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and performance scorecards.Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Plant Managers, DC Operations Leaders, Customer Care, and Commercial Divisions to align shipping schedules, prebuild movements, and peak volume execution. Strategic Transformation & Network of Excellence (Build & Adapt)Global NOE Governance: Act as the North American leader for the Global Transportation Network of Excellence (NOE). Deploy global standards, KPI definitions, auditing frameworks, and operating methodologies across the zone.Digital Suite & Systems (TMS/SAP): Own the roadmap, rollout, and optimization of our next-generation Transportation Management Systems (TMS), tracking tools, parcel rate-shopping engines, and operational analytics platforms.Network Redesign & Growth Strategy: Partner with Engineering and Fulfillment NOE leaders on multi-year network studies, identifying optimal flow paths, cross-dock opportunities, and fulfillment center positioning.Systems Remediation & Continuous Improvement: Lead operational readiness, post-go-live stabilization, and data cleansing initiatives following enterprise ERP and WMS implementations. Sustainability & Innovation (L'Oréal for the Future)Decarbonization Roadmap: Lead the zone transportation sustainability strategy to achieve company Net Zero targets.Green Freight Solutions: Evaluate, pilot, and scale lower-emission alternatives, including fleet electrification, alternative fuels, intermodal expansion, and optimized route density to actively offset volume growth. People & Organization LeadershipLead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team across Domestic Operations, International Operations, Continuous Improvement, and Systems.Foster a culture of accountability, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration across plant, DC, and corporate teams.

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, or end-to-end supply chain within large-scale, high-velocity consumer goods (CPG), retail, or complex manufacturing environments.Financial & Scale Acumen: Proven track record managing large-scale freight budgets ($100M+) with deep knowledge of North American carrier markets, parcel networks, LTL/TL dynamics, and intermodal transport.Systems & Digital Fluency: Extensive experience with enterprise-grade Transportation Management Systems (e.g., SAP TM, OTM, Blue Yonder, Manhattan) and modern visibility/telematics platforms.Procurement & Negotiation: Demonstrated success collaborating with sourcing teams on multi-million-dollar RFP events, contract negotiation, and carrier relationship management.Operational Mindset: Strong root-cause problem-solving capabilities with a bias toward data-driven execution and operational discipline.Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline (Master’s/MBA preferred).Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent, ongoing basis is required. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this roleBeing present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office-based roles for eligible full-time employees.

Preferred Attributes

Direct experience managing international freight, customs clearance, and global ocean/air lanes.Proven leadership in logistics sustainability programs (SmartWay, carbon accounting, alternative fleet deployment).High executive presence with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders, divisional general managers, and global stakeholders.Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and motivate teams.Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, data analysis tools, and Solvace.

What’s In It For You

Salary Range: $212,500 - 250,000 base salary (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level)Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan)Hybrid Work Policy (3 Days in Office, 2 Days Work from Home)Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!)Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance)Learning & Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!)Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs 

To learn more about L’Oréal’s commitment to sustainability, please click HERE  

Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

Job Description

Information Technology at Procter & Gamble is where business, innovation and technology integrate to build a competitive advantage for P&G. As a Data Engineer, you'll design, develop, and implement cloud-based data and analytics platforms (DAP) and pipelines that acquire, cleanse, transform, and publish data from a wide variety of sources.

Beyond building robust data solutions, you'll partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, and analytics teams to translate business needs into technical solutions, influence how data is structured and consumed, and help shape engineering standards across the team. Job Description:

The Program Manager – Value Leadership serves as the operating hub for the Value Leadership portfolio, ensuring project data, governance routines, savings visibility, risks, escalations, and cross-functional actions are captured accurately and advanced with clear ownership. This role brings structure to ambiguity and enables leaders and project owners to make timely, informed decisions. 

You will work closely with VL Leadership Director, Portfolio Directors, Project Leads, Finance, R&D, Commercial, Supply, Procurement, Manufacturing, Packaging, Logistics, and other senior stakeholders to maintain a reliable single source of truth for project status, savings, timing, approvals, risks, and decisions. The role supports the recurring VL operating rhythm, including project reviews, prioritization discussions, action tracking, escalation follow-up, reporting, and continuous improvement of portfolio tools and knowledge repositories. 

What are we looking for?  

Ideal candidate profile: A highly organized, analytically strong portfolio/program manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, manage recurring governance routines, synthesize complex project information into clear recommendations, drive follow-through across a matrixed organization, and coordinate (and potentially manage) a small team supporting portfolio execution.  Business experience: 5-8 years of experience in portfolio management, program management, PMO operations, financial/savings tracking, strategic planning, change management, or similar roles in a complex, matrixed organization.  Governance and process discipline: Familiarity with Stage Gate, project intake, scoping, and other governance processes, including process discipline, required fields, documentation standards, and consistent application across teams.  Analytical capabilities: Experience using project data, savings assumptions, timing, risk, and resource inputs to support scenario modeling, prioritization, investment analysis, portfolio trade-off discussions, dashboards, summaries, and leadership-ready materials.  Communication and influence: Strong stakeholder engagement, change management, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across levels, simplify complex portfolio trade-offs, and reinforce follow-through through concise, data-driven storytelling.  Working style: Comfortable working in ambiguity and shifting priorities, with strong organization, ownership, attention to detail, bias for action, and a continuous improvement mindset.  Tools and systems: Experience with portfolio, savings, reporting, and collaboration tools such as Sopheon Accolade/PPM, Sievo, Excel, Power Query, Power BI, SharePoint, Teams, project trackers, and action logs.  

What will be your responsibilities? 

Portfolio analysis and prioritization: Lead and support scenario modeling, prioritization views, and portfolio analysis to evaluate Value Leadership pipeline options, including impact, feasibility, savings potential, timing, risk, and resource trade-offs.  Decision support and storytelling: Translate portfolio analytics, project updates, and reporting outputs into clear recommendations and senior leader communications on portfolio health, value delivery, escalation needs, and open decisions.  Governance and operating rhythm: Support recurring Value Leadership project reviews, action tracking, decision documentation, escalation follow-up, and consistent use of the portfolio single source of truth.  Process adoption: Act as a change agent for portfolio processes, including idea management, DVF/project intake, recurring review routines, standard reporting practices, and non-consumer-facing Stage Gate deployment.  Capability building and knowledge management: Strengthen portfolio management capability through playbooks, onboarding materials, process guidance, recurring routines, documentation standards, and shared knowledge repositories.  Tool and process improvement: Identify portfolio tool, reporting, and process gaps; map continuous-improvement opportunities; and partner with technology, data, finance, and functional teams to deliver practical improvements.  Team and stakeholder coordination: Lead or indirectly guide project managers, workstream owners, coordinating priorities, clarifying ownership, tracking actions, and reinforcing accountability.

rows.title: Omni Customer Activation Director
rows.descriptionText:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Sales

Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in-stores and online. Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.

About The Role

Locations:  Nutley, NJ or Bentonville, AR

The Omni Customer Activation Director owns Reckitt’s omnichannel customer activation agenda across key US retailers, driving revenue growth through best-in-class digital shelf execution, retail media investment, shopper activation, and commercial partnerships with Sales and customer teams.

This role sits at the center of Reckitt’s commercial growth strategy, translating brand priorities into customer-led activation plans that accelerate traffic, conversion, and share across both eCommerce and physical retail environments.

Working closely with Sales leadership, Revenue Growth Management, and customer teams, this leader ensures Reckitt wins across the modern retail landscape through best-in-class digital shelf performance, retail media investment, pricing and promotion strategies, and omnichannel activation.

The role leads a high-performing team and plays a critical part in strengthening Reckitt’s customer partnerships and omnichannel growth capabilities across the US market.

Your responsibilities

Commercial Growth & Customer Activation

 Lead Reckitt’s omnichannel activation strategy across priority retailers, driving revenue growth, conversion, and market share. Translate brand priorities into customer-specific commercial activation plans that support joint business growth. Partner closely with Sales teams to unlock incremental growth opportunities across digital shelf, retail media, pricing, promotion, and assortment.

Digital Shelf Leadership

 Own Reckitt’s digital shelf performance across priority retailers, including search visibility, content excellence, assortment strategy, availability, and conversion. Partner with CAP and customer teams to continuously improve product page performance and online merchandising. Drive adoption of new eCommerce capabilities, analytics tools, and digital commerce technologies.

Omnichannel Activation & Shopper Programs

 Lead omnichannel activation programs across digital and physical retail environments. Provide strategic oversight of shopper marketing programs, ensuring strong alignment with commercial priorities and measurable sales impact. Ensure flawless execution across key retail events, promotional moments, and customer initiatives.

Revenue Growth & Investment Effectiveness

 Manage omnichannel activation investments and ensure strong ROI and commercial impact. Partner with Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance to optimize pricing, promotion, and price-pack architecture across channels. Champion a test-and-learn approach to continuously improve traffic, conversion, and retail media effectiveness.

Leadership & Organizational Impact

 Build and lead a high-performing omnichannel activation team. Drive clarity, pace, and accountability across cross-functional teams. Strengthen Reckitt’s omnichannel capabilities and customer partnerships across the US market.

This role is not currently sponsoring visas or considering international movement at this time.

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.10–12+ years of experience across Sales, eCommerce, omnichannel commerce, or customer strategy within CPG.Direct account management experience with major retailers is required. Candidates must have a proven track record of leading customer relationships and delivering joint business growth.Experience with P&L ownership and delivering against revenue, margin, and profitability targets.Strong experience working with major digital commerce platforms including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Instacart, DoorDash, and emerging last-mile ecosystems.Proven track record of driving revenue growth through digital shelf optimization, retail media investment, pricing and promotion strategies, and omnichannel activation.Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting joint business planning and customer growth strategies.Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Finance.Data-driven decision maker with strong analytics and performance management capabilities.Ability to travel up to 30% within the US.Skills for SuccessCustomer StrategyeCommerce StrategyDigital Shelf OptimizationRetail Media & Performance MarketingRevenue Growth ManagementShopper MarketingSales NegotiationP&L ManagementCommercial Strategy ExecutionCross-Functional Leadership

The skills for success

Key Account Management, Account Management, Ecommerce, Analysing sales and Ecommerce data, Field sales; Field sales management, Leadership skills, Consumer Insights; Shopper Insights; Customer Insights; Category Analysis, Collaboration and partnership skills; Influencing, Consultative Selling, Customer strategy; Channel strategy, Sales strategy development, Perform product planning, Business acumen; financial acumen, commercial accumen, Sales negotiation, P&L Management, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognize, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

US salary ranges

USD $188,000.00 - $282,000.00

US pay transparency

The base salary range for this role will vary based on experience in job and industry, training and education, skills relevant to the position, and other factors permitted by law. In addition to the base salary, the position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, which is subject to change each year. Reckitt offers eligible employees competitive benefits including medical, prescription, dental, vision, life and disability insurance; paid time off for vacation, sick, and Company recognized holidays; a 401(K) plan; generous paid parental leave; adoption and fertility support; tuition reimbursement; product discounts; and much more!

If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete your application, please contact NAtalentacquisition@reckitt.com. Reckitt is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

Equality

We recognize that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; color, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Experience

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

5+ years of professional experience in retirement plan administration, benefits, HR, or related field.

Competencies

Preferred Qualifications

SAP/SuccessFactors experience preferred.Experience designing or operating business controls (SOX/internal control environment, audit readiness, or data quality controls).Familiarity with ERISA, IRS, and DOL regulations.Experience with complex pension or payroll issues.Experience with user acceptance testing or implementing new HRIS/pension systems.Experience with ServiceNow or other applicable case management system.

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. rows.title: Global Lead, M&M’S Immersive Experiences
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Global Lead, M&M’S Immersive Experiences will define and lead the global strategy for how consumers experience M&M'S across our connected ecosystem of physical and digital touchpoints.

This role is responsible for developing the long-term vision, strategic priorities, and execution oversight for branded immersive experiences, ensuring they work together to deliver a seamless and engaging consumer journey.

A critical transformation for this leader will be connecting historically siloed channels, including M&M'S retail stores, M&M'S.com, brand activations, sponsorship experiences, and digital content experiences, into an integrated ecosystem that amplifies brand equity, drives engagement, and drives business growth.

The role will partner closely with Brand & Content, Digital, Retail, Regional Marketing, and Commercial teams to ensure immersive experiences are planned, designed, executed, and optimized as a unified consumer journey.

What are we looking for?

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Design, Retail, Digital Commerce, or related field required, MBA or other advanced degree preferred.10+ years of experience in brand marketing, consumer experience, experiential marketing, retail experience, digital experience, or related disciplines.Experience leading large-scale consumer experience programs.Demonstrated success managing cross-functional and agency partnerships.Experience leading both digital and physical experience ecosystems preferred.Retail and direct-to-consumer experience preferred.Experience with flagship retail concepts, experiential activation, and digital engagement platforms preferred.Experience working within global or multi-market organizations.

What will be your key responsibilities?

Define The Global Immersive Experiences Strategy

Develop the global vision and strategic roadmap for M&M'S immersive experiences across physical and digital channels.Establish the role immersive experiences will play in strengthening brand equity, driving consumer engagement, and driving growth.Identify opportunities to create connected experiences across retail, digital, content, and brand activations.Champion a consumer-centric approach grounded in consumer insights, cultural relevance, and emerging experience trends.

Lead The Connected M&M'S Experience Ecosystem

Transform the current fragmented experience landscape into a connected global ecosystem.Ensure M&M'S Stores, M&M'S.com, experiential activations, sponsorship programs, and digital content environments work together as a cohesive brand experience.Build frameworks that enable consistency while allowing for regional and local market adaptation.Create clear experience principles and design standards that guide future development.

Physical Immersive Experiences Leadership

Provide strategic leadership and oversight for M&M'S branded physical experiences globally.Oversee experience strategy for:M&M'S retail storesCultural experiencesPartnership activationsExperiential elements supporting major brand campaignsEnsure experiences meaningfully reinforce the M&M'S brand narrative while delivering measurable business outcomes.Partner closely with Retail and Commercial teams on planning and operational considerations.

Digital Immersive Experiences Leadership

Lead strategy and governance for M&M'S digital experience platforms.Oversee the evolution of M&M'S.com as a key consumer engagement and experience destination.Partner with Brand & Content and Social teams to define digital content requirements that support immersive experiences.Ensure digital experiences are integrated with physical touchpoints to create connected consumer journeys.Evaluate emerging technologies and platforms that can enhance brand storytelling and engagement.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the central connector across Brand & Content, Retail, Digital, Consumer Experience, Regional Teams, and agency partners.Lead integrated planning processes that align experience development with global brand priorities.Influence senior stakeholders across functions and geographies to drive alignment and prioritization.Ensure operational, technical, commercial, and consumer considerations are incorporated from concept through execution.

Measurement and Optimization

Establish KPIs and success metrics for immersive experiences across physical and digital environments.Develop measurement frameworks linking experiences to brand health, consumer engagement, traffic, conversion, and business performance.Lead ongoing optimization efforts through consumer feedback, analytics, and post-program evaluations.

Leadership Responsibilities

Critical Success Factors

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

Experience developing and scaling consumer experiences across both physical and digital environments.Ability to connect multiple consumer touchpoints into cohesive ecosystem experiences.Strong strategic thinking coupled with operational excellence.Exceptional stakeholder management and influence skills.Experience leading highly cross-functional initiatives in complex global organizations.Deep understanding of brand building, consumer engagement, and experience design.Ability to translate consumer and business insights into compelling experiences that drive measurable results.A passion for innovation, creativity, and creating memorable brand moments.

Team Leadership

,

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, Risk Management, or related field.

rows.title: Commercial Finance Director
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Commercial Finance Director is the lead Finance representative on the Commercial Leadership Team and owns the Finance agenda for the Commercial organization. As the strategic finance partner to the VP of Commercial, this role provides independent financial leadership, constructive challenge, and an outside-in perspective to shape sourcing strategy and decisions.

The role provides financial leadership across a multi-billion-dollar direct material portfolio and is accountable for translating commodity markets, supplier economics, internal performance, and business plans into clear actions that create sustainable value. This leader guides the Commercial Finance team and establishes the Finance agenda across value creation, productivity governance, supplier economics, forecasting, planning, portfolio decision support, risk management, financial stewardship, and talent development.

The role connects Commercial with Portfolio Growth Teams (PGTs), partnering with PGT leaders and Finance to bring forward-looking perspectives on material cost drivers, supplier and commodity exposure, risks, opportunities, and sourcing trade-offs into portfolio decisions. The role helps ensure sourcing implications are understood early and reflected in growth plans, innovation choices, margin delivery, and portfolio priorities.

Reporting and insight foundations are well established. The next evolution is to use these capabilities more strategically by strengthening the productivity pipeline, improving decision quality, deepening supplier and cost insights, and delivering targeted digital enhancements that make analysis faster, more predictive, and easier to act on.

This role sits at the intersection of Commercial strategy, sourcing execution, portfolio growth, and financial performance. It offers the opportunity to influence some of the business’s most important sourcing and portfolio decisions, shape the value creation agenda across a multi-billion-dollar spend base, partner directly with senior leaders, and build the next generation of Finance talent. Success requires balancing external market dynamics, supplier economics, productivity delivery, supply resilience, and growth ambitions to enable profitable and sustainable growth.

What are we looking for?

Proven finance leadership experience in commercial, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or FP&A, with accountability for a significant business or spend portfolio.Strong business partnering skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, and translate analysis into clear decisions and actions.Strong financial grounding across analysis, modeling, forecasting, planning, performance management, and controls.Commercial judgment and curiosity about external markets, supplier economics, and sourcing dynamics.Experience leading and developing teams, setting priorities, building capability, and creating meaningful development opportunities.Clear, concise executive communication skills, with judgment to focus leaders on the most material risks, opportunities, and decisions.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent qualification is preferred.

What Will Be Your Key Responsibilities?

Commercial Finance Leadership and Business Partnership:

Serve as the lead Finance representative on the Commercial Leadership Team, owning the Finance agenda for Commercial and bringing an enterprise perspective to sourcing and business decisions.Partner with the VP of Commercial and senior Commercial leaders to shape strategy through insight, constructive challenge, and clear financial implications.Connect Commercial decisions to enterprise, PGT, and financial priorities, including growth, margin, cost, cash, service, quality, resilience, and sustainable value creation.

Value Creation, Productivity, and Supplier Economics:

Lead financial governance of the primes productivity agenda, including pipeline sufficiency, initiative valuation, phasing, risk assessment, validation, and performance tracking.Translate commodity markets, supplier economics, industry dynamics, and macroeconomic trends into clear implications for Mars.Partner with Commercial leaders to identify new sources of value across categories, suppliers, specifications, demand, terms, working capital, and sourcing models.

Portfolio Insights & Decision Support:

Partner with PGT leaders and PGT Finance to translate sourcing strategies, commodity outlooks, supplier economics, and material cost exposure into portfolio-level financial drivers, risks, and opportunities.Connect PGT priorities back to Commercial category strategies and help align sourcing actions, productivity plans, and supplier decisions with portfolio needs.Provide clear scenarios and trade-offs so PGTs can balance growth, profitability, supply resilience, quality, and longer-term value creation.

Forecasting, Planning, and Performance Management:

Lead the primes forecasting and planning agenda, ensuring assumptions are transparent, appropriately challenged, and translated into clear financial outcomes.Guide analysis of commodity inflation or deflation, productivity, mix, timing, and other drivers, with clear visibility of risks and opportunities.Lead performance reviews with Commercial and Finance leaders and convert insights into decisions, actions, owners, and follow-through.

Financial Stewardship, Controls, and Digital Enablement:

Maintain effective oversight of retained period-close activities within the Commercial Finance team while keeping the role primarily focused on forward-looking leadership and value creation.Ensure accurate financial results, strong governance over assumptions and savings recognition, and timely escalation of material financial risks.Strengthen reporting, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled enhancements where they improve decision quality, forecasting agility, or efficiency.

Team Leadership and Talent Development:

Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Finance team, setting clear priorities, standards, and accountability.Build capability in financial analysis, commercial acumen, storytelling, business partnering, digital tools, and value creation.Organize team capacity and ways of working to focus resources on the highest-value priorities while delivering core financial responsibilities.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The Enterprise Data & AI organization is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and services that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, AI-driven data analytics and insights, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, while embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency. 

Core Responsibilities

As a Director, Product & Program Management, you will be accountable for defining and executing the Enterprise Data & AI product portfolio, ensuring the successful delivery of AI and data capabilities that create measurable business value. You will lead the technical product and program management function that connects business priorities with the Data and AI platform engineering, AI initiatives, and AI research teams, and you will partner with business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-scale AI solutions and data and AI services.

You will establish the operating rhythm for defining the enterprise AI priorities, portfolio planning, prioritization, execution, and reporting, while shaping the enterprise roadmap for AI and data use cases. Working closely with business leaders, you will identify opportunities to accelerate value through AI, manage strategic technology partnerships, and enable rapid experimentati on with emerging technologies through safe and scalable proof-of-concept processes.

Lead product strategy and portfolio management

Drive technical program execution and governance

Accelerate innovation and partnerships

Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Business , Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree is an asset.  10+ years of experience leading enterprise product management,technicalprogram management,orportfolio delivery within technology organizations.  Experience delivering large-scale data, AI/ML, analytics, or platform initiatives across multiple business and technology teams.  Demonstrated success defining product roadmaps, managing cross-functional portfolios, and translating business strategy into executable delivery plans. Experience in retail context preferred.  Experience leading product discovery, prioritization, and proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging technologies.  Strong understanding of agile product development, portfolio management, and software delivery practices. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and executive influence skills with the ability to build alignment across business and technology organizations  Proven experience hiring, developing, and leading high-performing global teams. 

 must haves

Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.  Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.  Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.  Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.
