rows.title: 2027 Operations Analyst Graduate Apprenticeship Programme Glasgow
rows.descriptionText:
Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits

Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Business Management Graduate Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Operations Apprenticeship programme?

Operations keeps Barclays moving for customers, clients and colleagues. You’ll learn how banking services are delivered, how processes are improved, and how teams work together to manage risk, solve problems and provide excellent service.

Are you eligible?

First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need SQA Highers at ABBB or equivalent.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031). You must be residing in Scotland from 1 August 2027.

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In Glasgow

Our state-of-the-art campus in Glasgow is somewhere you'll want to work. It's home to colleagues who thrive in an environment designed with collaboration and the future of work in mind, with creative spaces, technology and plenty to get involved in outside your day job.

What happens once you apply?

Step 1 - We'll review your application

Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments

Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility

Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)

Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To support the day-to-day operations of the operations business division providing insights and expertise that help more senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities

Accountabilities


Performance of KYC tasks while following standard procedures related to Client Due Diligence and AML policies.Monitoring of real time transaction flow, trade updates and exception queues to ensure timely and accurate trade representation across systems.Address incident, problem and change management issues to improve services across the bank.Provision of support to continuous improvement of the operational process and the development of best practices; coming up with ways to improve systems and processes.Provision of support for cleared derivatives, performing perform daily reconciliation of related fees undertake a range of complex customer and product related processing activities.Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.


Analyst Expectations


To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer servicePerform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standardNo people leadership roles at this grade.Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: HR Operations & Payroll Advisor
rows.descriptionText:
The HR Operations & Payroll Advisor will play a key role in supporting the separation of BPL as it transitions to operating independently. Working as part of the HR team, the role will provide hands-on HR operational support to managers and colleagues throughout the separation, with a particular focus on HR administration, employee queries, HRIS transition, payroll and Day 1 readiness.

The HR Operations & Payroll Advisor will be a key first point of contact for HR queries, providing timely and practical support while triaging more complex or specialist matters to the relevant HR Centres of Excellence (COEs).

This is an opportunity to join a business undergoing significant transformation and to play a key role in standing up new HR infrastructure and processes, including the transition from Workday to the new HRIS and supporting payroll through the separation and dual-run period.

Key Responsibilities


The key initial focus for this role is to support the wider HR team in delivering the separation programme and to provide hands-on support during periods of increased activity around Day 1, payroll transition and HRIS implementationEnsure HR data in the HRIS is accurate and easily reportableSupport managers and colleagues with day-to-day queries on how to use the HRIS and complete any system administration that is required Help establish robust and efficient HR processes for the standalone businessSupport testing and readiness activities ahead of key transition milestonesAct as a first point of contact for generalist manager and colleague HR queries across BPL, triaging more complex queries to the relevant HR COEProvide timely, accurate advice on HR policies, processes and employee lifecycle mattersIdentify recurring queries and process issues and use this to improve available guidanceAct as a key point of contact for payroll-related colleague and manager queriesAssist with payroll input, validation, reconciliationSupport key payroll activities including starters, leavers, changes to personal details, salary changes, bonuses and other employee data impacting payrollSupport the dual running of payroll during the transition to the new operating modelPrepare HR documentation and correspondence as requiredProduce regular HR reports and data to support the HR team and wider businessMaintain appropriate confidentiality and data protection standard when handling employee information


To be successful as a HR Operations & Payroll Advisor, you will have experience with: 


Previous experience working in a HR Services and Payroll teamGood working knowledge of core HR processes and the employee lifecycleGood understanding of payroll processes and the ability to investigate payroll-related issuesExperience working with HRIS platforms; Workday experience is desirable for this first separation phaseStrong attention to detail, particularly when working with employee data and payrollComfortable working with spreadsheets, data validation and reconciliationExperience supporting an HRIS implementation would be advantageousComfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment with competing priorities


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate will be based in London. Our offices are located at 1 Churchill Place and 7 Westferry Circus (new BPL office). We support a hybrid working pattern with 3 days per week office-based presence expected.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients. 

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years. 

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

Join Barclays as a Product Owner.

At Barclays, we're transforming the way we deliver products and experiences for our customers. As a Product Owner, you will play a critical role in maximising product value by defining a clear product vision and ensuring delivery teams focus on the work that matters most.

You will be responsible for authoring, refining and prioritising the product backlog, balancing customer desirability, business viability and technical feasibility to ensure the right solutions are built at the right time.

Deep understanding of Agile principles, product discovery, backlog management, prioritisation, iterative delivery, experimentation and continuous improvement is essential.


Some other highly valued skills may include;


Experience defining and measuring product adoption, customer experience and value realisation metrics, using data to continuously improve persona journeys and product outcomes.Deep expertise across modern data ecosystems, including metadata management, data lineage, data products, data modelling, data curation, APIs, analytics, event streaming, and data platforms operating across hybrid cloud and on-premise environments.Experience leading large-scale transformation initiatives, particularly the modernisation of legacy data platforms and the adoption of federated data products and self-service data capabilities.Agile certifications (e.g. SAFe, Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master) and experience applying Agile practices at scale across cross-functional product and engineering teams.

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities


Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.  Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives.  Lead, coach, and develop the U.S. Immigration Specialist (L4), providing strategic direction, prioritization, performance management, and career development. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of U.S. business immigration experience, demonstrating deep expertise in employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.  5+ program management experience, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution.  5+ years operating in complex, matrixed organizations, partnering with Senior level stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with a track record of developing scalable programs and delivering measurable business impact.  Experience managing external immigration vendors, including governance, performance management, commercial oversight, vendor selection, and contract management.  Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve program effectiveness and stakeholder experience.  Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions at all levels of the organization.  Passion for delivering exceptional employee and stakeholder experiences.

Uber's Commercial Sales Enablement team supports our multi-billion dollar Delivery business, including Uber Eats, Grocery & Retail, Direct, and Uber Advertising. As the Global Ads Enablement Lead, you will own the enablement strategy and execution for Uber's global Advertising sales organization, serving as a strategic partner to Ads Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and regional and global commercial leaders.

In this role, you will translate Uber Advertising's commercial strategy, growth priorities, and evolving product portfolio into scalable enablement programs that strengthen seller capability and improve commercial execution across regions. From accelerating new-hire productivity and strengthening solution selling, measurement, negotiation, and executive engagement capabilities to enabling critical product launches, account planning, and adoption of seller technology and AI, you will lead a global portfolio of work designed to change seller behavior and improve commercial performance around the world.

This role requires someone who can move seamlessly between strategy and execution, influence senior global stakeholders, use data to identify and prioritize performance opportunities, and lead a team that enables sellers to evolve from product-focused selling toward outcome-oriented, multi-product customer partnerships.

 Lead the Global Ads Enablement strategy and roadmap, translating Ads commercial priorities, performance data, seller needs, product roadmaps, and regional requirements into a focused portfolio of programs that improve seller and client partner productivity, capability, and business outcomes. Drive readiness and adoption for complex Ads product, measurement, process, sales technology, and AI transformations, coordinating stakeholder alignment, communications, training, manager reinforcement, launch execution, and post-launch adoption across multiple regions and seller roles.  Advance Uber Advertising's evolution toward outcome-oriented selling by equipping sellers to diagnose customer business objectives, position Uber's differentiated advertising solutions, navigate complex buying organizations, and develop deeper, longer-term customer partnerships. Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to design, deliver, and scale enablement programs, including using AI-powered tools to improve learning, content, workflows, personalization, or seller productivity. rows.title: Principal, Corporate Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Company

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be part of the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be a part of.

With ~150 million active buyers across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit www.ebayinc.com

About The Team

We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The corporate strategy has a reputation of solving the most challenging problems and coming up with innovative and out-of-the-box solutions, with recommendations grounded in data.

We work very closely with senior leadership and have a high visibility. Team members can have a fast-track career in strategy or move into the business after 1-2 years.

The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: 1) we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, 2) we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, 3) we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The eBay corporate strategy team is seeking a Principal, Corporate Strategy. Within this role, you will lead a cross-functional strategy project and a team of a few strategy team members. You will work with key stakeholders from all functions across the organization to craft strategies and drive structured and data-based recommendations to action. In this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay, working with eBay’s senior executives. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems. You can either build a career in eBay’s strategy team or use this as stepping stone into other business and product roles at eBay.

Role Responsibilities

Project leadership: Lead cross-functional projects to solve strategic business problems, working with senior eBay executives. Projects are usually 2-4 months long, staffed with 1-3 team members supporting the Principal. Topics can span eBay’s overall strategy, category strategies, buyer/seller strategies or functional strategies (e.g., payments, ads) or other relevant strategic topics Insights generation: Work with your team and analytics/ data science support to define smart analyses and generate new, compelling insights. Visualize in simple and compelling ways. Use the insights to develop key recommendations grounded in data Strategy Development: Define and structure the core problem, understand status quo & competitive dynamics, define ambitions and value proposition and create recommendations for key actions to solve the problem Communication: Develop compelling and concise storylines to communicate team’s recommendation; prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership People leadership: Develop a team of associates and managers to constantly improve and help them grow their career 


Job Requirements

Intellectual curiosity Skilled in project management and strategy development, including project prioritization, hypotheses development, financial and business modeling, strategic options identification, consensus building, and implementation Outstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative), ability to define relevant analyses in a hypothesis-driven approach, generating new & groundbreaking insights grounded in data Excellence in structured thinking, developing creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. Ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive business Strong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions. Ability to create clear and simple storylines. Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives. Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team members Comfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environment Comfort in handling uncertainty Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with! 


Qualifications

Proven leader with at least 7+ years of work experience - experience at a top strategy consulting firm is a must; Experienced project managers, currently working at top strategy consulting companies. Leaders who spent at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting company and then advanced their careers for 4-5 years at a startup or corporate Bachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferred Expertise in technology and/or in e-commerce/retail is a plus 


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work.. To learn about our Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$178,800 - $238,700

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Manager, Loyalty & Personalized Offers supports the execution of Macy’s external loyalty partnership strategy and manages internal stakeholder relationships to drive member engagement through targeted lifecycle offers. This role requires expertise in campaign management, omnichannel marketing, and partnership development and is ideal for a marketing professional who thrives in a high-performance, results-driven retail environment. The Manager collaborates closely with internal and external marketing partners to develop and execute strategies that enhance loyalty program value, strengthen customer engagement, and support business objectives.

What You Will Do

Partner with the Sr. Manager, Loyalty Offers to shape Macy’s loyalty partnership strategy, including program objectives, go-to-market plans, and the technology and communication roadmap.Lead the end-to-end management of key loyalty partnerships by identifying opportunities that enhance customer value, optimizing partnership assets, executing activation plans, and managing day-to-day partner relationships.Develop and launch strategic loyalty offers in collaboration with Marketing Effectiveness, Analytics, and Merchandise Marketing partners.Design and execute test-and-learn strategies to drive innovation, evaluate performance against key loyalty KPIs, increase customer lifetime value, and optimize offer timing and cadence.Influence cross-functional partners to develop and expand credit and loyalty promotions and programs while ensuring strategic alignment, mutual business value, brand compliance, and marketing effectiveness.Manage and enhance the omnichannel customer experience related to loyalty partnerships and offers, including the supporting roadmap.Analyze partnership and offer performance and communicate results, insights, and recommendations to key stakeholders.Monitor competitive loyalty programs and market activity to inform strategy and ensure an effective competitive response.Maintain regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing: Expertise in developing and executing loyalty, retention, and customer engagement strategies that drive member growth and lifetime value.

Partnership Management: Ability to identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships that enhance customer value and support business objectives.

Campaign Management: Strong experience leading omnichannel marketing campaigns from strategy and offer development through execution and optimization.

Strategic Thinking & Innovation: Ability to develop go-to-market strategies, roadmap initiatives, and test-and-learn programs that drive business results and continuous improvement.

Data Analysis & Performance Measurement: Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure campaign effectiveness, interpret performance data, and deliver actionable insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Merchandising, Technology, and external partners to achieve shared goals.

Communication & Relationship Building: Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships and effectively communicate strategies, results, and recommendations.

Customer-Centric Marketing: Strong understanding of personalization, customer experience, and omnichannel engagement strategies that strengthen loyalty and brand affinity.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3-5 years of related experience. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today! 

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. 

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

A successful candidate in the Director of Brand & Marketing role is a champion multi-tasker, a brilliant communicator and coordinator with a strong ability to manage priorities and projects in a dynamic environment. Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that strengthen brand positioning, drive awareness, generate demand, and contribute to revenue growth.  Demonstrated leadership experience, including the ability to manage, mentor, and develop team members and effectively lead cross-functional initiatives.  Strong understanding of luxury hospitality, including the guest journey and the marketing of rooms, food and beverage, spa, events, meetings, and other experiential offerings. At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. About The Team And The Role

eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the international growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.

In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.

This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.

You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.

Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex media, audience, and revenue concepts to diverse audiences.

Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, along with experience using advertising platforms such as GAM, DV360, Meta, Nielsen, Comscore, and CRM tools such as Salesforce.

rows.title: Accountant I - Gross Margin
rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story.Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.
Job OverviewThe Accountant I is responsible for the timely and accurate accounting and reporting of sales and gross margin across all retail operating divisions. The Accountant I ensures all accounting is in strict compliance with GAAP and supports both internal and external audit requests. Additionally, the role involves performing routine journal entries and balancing procedures, identifying and investigating variances, and implementing solutions. The Accountant I also supports the People Leader in team projects, system or process testing, and monitoring processes for accuracy. This position contributes to the design, implementation, and analysis of company strategic initiatives, handles related ad hoc requests, and fulfills any tax-related inquiries or requests. The Accountant I plays an integral role in maintaining financial integrity and operational efficiency across the organization.
What You Will DoRecord weekly entries and reports related to gross margin, troubleshoot financial systems, and analyze data for sales and gross margin performance.Develop and execute SQL queries using tools such as Google BigQuery to extract data from multiple data sources, create financial analyses, and maintain reporting processes as they evolve.Assist in the monthly closing of gross margin components for financial statements, communicate exceptions to business units, and follow up on responses. Investigate out-of-balance situations and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.Perform monthly balance sheet account reconciliations, analyze and report variances, and create consolidated reports as needed. Ensure all reconciliations are completed accurately and in compliance with accounting standards.Assist with internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation, schedules, and support for financial analysis.Handle any tax-related inquiries or requests from internal teams, external parties, or regulatory bodies, ensuring compliance with applicable tax laws and accurate documentation.Participate in the design, testing, and implementation of financial systems, assist with system rollouts, and provide user support as necessary.Provide key insights and analytics related to company strategic initiatives, helping to drive revenue growth and improve financial performance.Actively contribute to the identification and resolution of process inefficiencies and assist in implementing better practices for team efficiencies.Work cross-functionally with various departments to ensure smooth operations and accurate financial reporting. Support the team with ad hoc requests and projects as needed.Ensure regular, dependable attendance and punctuality to meet department and company needs.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.
Skills You Will NeedGAAP and Accounting Principles: Strong understanding of GAAP and basic accounting principles, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial reporting.Financial Analysis and Reporting: Expertise in financial analysis, reporting, and reconciliation processes, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve complex financial issues.SQL and Data Management: Proficiency in developing and executing SQL queries using tools such as Google BigQuery to extract and analyze data from multiple sources.Advanced Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, enabling complex data analysis, reporting, and financial modeling.Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information in a clear and concise manner.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, including marketing, merchandising, and operations, to ensure accurate financial reporting and alignment with business goals.Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and address financial discrepancies, with the ability to think critically in resolving issues.Independent and Initiative-Driven: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high performance.Strategic and Creative Thinking: Ability to think strategically, creatively, and technically to address business challenges and capitalize on opportunities.
Who You AreCandidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 1-2 years of relevant experience preferred.This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

Chewy is seeking a Finance Manager to join our high-impact Commercial Finance team, supporting the Hard Goods business! rows.title: Data Engineer II, Financial Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

At Chewy, Financial Intelligence is building trusted, scalable, and well-governed data solutions that enable Finance and Accounting teams to make faster, more informed decisions. We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer II to design, develop, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support financial reporting, analytics, planning, and operational decision-making across the enterprise.

In this role, you will focus on transforming complex financial and operational data into reliable, well-structured, and reusable data models using dbt Cloud and Snowflake. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Analytics, and other business partners to understand business processes, define requirements, and translate those needs into scalable technical solutions and trusted data products.

The ideal candidate brings strong SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and data modeling expertise, along with the ability to work directly with business users and explain technical concepts in clear business terms. This is an opportunity to strengthen Chewy's Financial Intelligence data foundation, improve the consistency and usability of financial data, and help Finance and Accounting teams access trusted information more efficiently.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain scalable data models in dbt Cloud and Snowflake that support Finance, Accounting, reporting, planning, and analytical use cases.Partner directly with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to understand business processes, reporting requirements, data definitions, and analytical needs.Translate business requirements into well-designed, reusable, and maintainable dimensional, fact, aggregation, and analytical data models.Build and support ETL/ELT processes that transform source data into trusted analytical datasets, with a primary emphasis on transformation and modeling.Implement data quality controls and validation to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of financial data.Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, reporting issues, transformation failures, and differences between source systems and downstream financial reporting.Optimize SQL and dbt models for performance, maintainability, scalability, and cost efficiency while documenting model dependencies, transformations, and metric definitions.Identify opportunities to simplify data transformations, reduce manual Finance processes, improve self-service access to trusted data, and apply practical automation where it adds value.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence engineering, or a related data discipline.Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience developing complex transformations and analytical data models.Strong hands-on experience with dbt, including model development, testing, documentation, dependencies, reusable components, and development best practices.Experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, grain, relationships, slowly changing dimensions, and reusable analytical datasets.Demonstrated experience working directly with business users and analysts to gather requirements, validate solutions, troubleshoot data issues, and explain technical concepts in business terms.Experience supporting Finance, Accounting, FP&A, financial reporting, or other financial data domains preferred, with strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder partnership skills.

The work spans scalable development initiatives—such as new concepts and prototypes—as well as core programs including retail, breakfast, bars, and restaurants. How You'll Collaborate With Others

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

The Global Marketing team drives revenue and brand performance across WSI's global brands through integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and business results. Spanning social media, influencer marketing, PR, brand activations, and marketing operations, the team collaborates closely with brand, creative, e-commerce, merchandising, PR, and international teams to deliver cohesive, customer-focused campaigns.

About The Role

The Global Assistant Brand Marketing Manager supports the planning, testing and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across social media, influencer, PR, and brand activation efforts.

This role requires an organized, creative, and analytical marketer who can manage multiple projects, work cross-functionally, and use campaign insights to optimize future activity.

The ideal candidate brings experience in brand, social, or influencer marketing and a strong understanding of how to build community and brand affinity across international markets.

Responsibilities


Collaborate with internal marketing, creative, e-commerce, merchandising, PR, and international teams to deliver cohesive global marketing initiatives.Lead the execution of influencer partnerships across international markets, including Canada, Australia, and the UK. Manage end-to-end influencer campaigns, including campaign briefs, talent curation, rate negotiation, contracts, product fulfilment, relationship management, and reporting. Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, talent managers, agencies, PR partners, and internal stakeholders to support successful collaborations.Serve as the global social media subject matter expert, sharing best practices, supporting local teams, and identifying opportunities to improve performance.Partner with creative, local marketing, and e-marketing teams to brief, create, curate, and optimize organic and paid social content.Support the testing and optimization of creative, messaging, and campaign approaches using performance insights.Analyze social media, influencer, and campaign performance to provide actionable insights and recommendations that inform future marketing strategies.Prepare and present campaign performance insights and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.Identify opportunities to source and leverage user-generated content across global marketing initiatives.Support global PR initiatives, product launches, seasonal campaigns, events, activations, sweepstakes, and giveaways across international markets.Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, user-generated content opportunities, and emerging social platforms to bring fresh ideas to the business.Manage marketing operations, including budgets, invoices, contracts, forecasts, accruals, reporting, and campaign administration to ensure projects are delivered accurately and efficiently.


Criteria


3+ years of experience in digital, social media, influencer, PR, brand marketing, or a related field; bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience preferred.Experience managing social media channels, influencer campaigns, or integrated marketing initiatives, ideally for a brand with national or international reach.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to write clear, concise copy and adopt a brand voice clearly and authentically.Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables and the ability to analyze and report on marketing performance.Experience using social media management platforms such as Meta Business Suite, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, or similar tools.Experience with Airtable, Figma, or similar project management and creative collaboration tools is a plus.Experience interpreting campaign and social analytics to optimize performance and inform creative development.Comfortable working cross-functionally with creative, e-commerce, merchandising, PR, and international teams.Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and manage internal and external stakeholders confidently and professionally.Proactive, creative, flexible, and solutions-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of projects and learn new platforms, tools, and marketing best practices.This role requires being onsite in the office Monday through Thursday, with Friday optional in the office.


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $70,000- $80,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg is a leading provider of news and financial information. The News Product, Technology and Publishing team develops solutions that give Bloomberg Terminal customers access to the most critical information impacting financial markets from more than 200,000 news and social media sources.

What’s the role?

We are looking for a dynamic, analytical and commercially-minded Content Strategist to help prepare social media and news content for an agentic AI future.

In this role, you will work within the Content & Audience Strategy team to shape how news, analysis and expert content should evolve as client workflows become increasingly AI-mediated.

You will help translate customer needs, market trends, product priorities, audience data and editorial expertise into clear content strategies that guide product, use case, sourcing, metadata and measurement decisions.

This is an individual contributor role reporting into the Head of Content Strategy. The team is responsible for shaping Bloomberg’s content strategy across regions and subject areas, ensuring content on the Terminal remains relevant, trusted and impactful for clients. The broader team works closely with newsroom, product, technology, data, research, sales and marketing partners to align content strategy with client needs and Bloomberg’s business priorities.

Your initial focus will include developing a new approach to sourcing and structuring influential expert voices in the market, as well as developing sustainable commercial models for this content. As market commentary becomes more distributed across newsletters, independent analysts, expert communities, social media and other external platforms, Bloomberg has an opportunity to identify, evaluate and integrate high-signal perspectives into Terminal workflows.

This role is about helping Bloomberg’s content become more useful to human readers and more legible to AI systems. That means thinking carefully about client workflows and needs, structure, metadata, event identity, source authority, signal quality, client intent and how content is retrieved, cited and recomposed in AI-powered workflows.

We’ll Trust You To

Develop clear, evidence-based content strategies for priority areas of Bloomberg’s offeringHelp prepare Bloomberg’s content for agentic AI workflows, where systems proactively surface, contextualize and help clients act on informationTranslate broad strategic questions into practical recommendations for content, product, personaS, sourcing, metadata and measurementClarify what content needs to exist, how it should be structured, and what metadata or classification is required for AI systems to retrieve and interpret it accuratelyDevelop frameworks for identifying, evaluating and sourcing influential expert voices, including independent analysts, specialist commentators and other market-relevant perspectivesHelp define source selection criteria, credibility signals and governance models for externally sourced expert contentUse audience insights, usage data, client feedback, competitive analysis and editorial judgment to identify content gaps and opportunitiesCreate concise strategy documents, recommendations, frameworks and briefing materials for senior stakeholdersPartner with newsroom, product, data, engineering, sales and other teams to turn strategy into practical next stepsHelp define what success looks like for content strategies, including client outcomes, usage signals, AI retrieval quality and business impactMaintain alignment across teams by turning complex, cross-functional issues into shared language and clear decision points

You’ll Need To Have

Experience in content strategy, news strategy, editorial strategy, product strategy, audience strategy or a related field5+ years of experience in news, financial information, social media, product, research, strategy or another fast-moving content environmentStrong understanding of how professional audiences use news, commentary, analysis and market information to make decisionsStrong interest in how AI is changing the way clients discover, consume and act on news and informationAbility to turn complex content and product questions into clear strategic frameworksStrong written communication skills, with the ability to produce crisp, structured documents for senior stakeholdersStrong analytical judgment, including comfort working with both quantitative data and qualitative evidenceAbility to work across editorial, product, data, technology and commercial teamsComfort operating in ambiguous areas where the answer is not yet obvious and the work requires discovery, synthesis and judgmentStrong organizational skills and ability to move several strategic workstreams forward at once

We’d Love To See

Familiarity with financial markets, business news or professional information productsExperience developing strategy for content products, news workflows, content classification, metadata, discovery or user engagementUnderstanding of real-time news workflows, including alerting, monitoring, breaking news, escalation and follow-upFamiliarity with AI-mediated search, retrieval, summarization or answer experiencesExperience thinking about how unstructured content can be made more structured, discoverable and reusableUnderstanding of how client segments differ in their news needs, from real-time decision makers to deep research usersExperience using audience data, product analytics or client research to shape recommendationsAbility to balance editorial judgment, client utility, product feasibility and commercial impactA collaborative mindset and ability to influence without direct authorityComfort working in a high-paced, demanding and evolving environment

Description & Requirements

Our Team

Bloomberg's Portfolio & Risk Analytics business delivers some of the industry's most sophisticated risk management, valuation, portfolio construction, and investment analytics solutions to leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, hedge funds, and sovereign institutions around the world.

This is powered by Bloomberg's Multi-Asset Class Model (MAC3), a proprietary factor-based risk model designed to help institutional investors understand, measure, and manage portfolio risk across global asset classes. The model provides forward-looking risk estimates and decomposes portfolio risk into systematic market factors and asset-specific (idiosyncratic) risk, providing a comprehensive view of the drivers of portfolio volatility and diversification. MAC3 is also utilized to support portfolio construction and optimization. Investors can use the model to evaluate proposed trades, manage factor exposures, assess diversification, incorporate investment constraints, and understand how changes in portfolio composition may affect overall risk.

Unlike models built for a single asset class, MAC3 is designed to deliver a consistent risk framework across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, derivatives, and alternatives, enabling investors to evaluate risk and construct portfolios holistically across diversified investment strategies.

What's the Role?

We are seeking a highly collaborative, technically sophisticated, and commercially driven Risk Model Sales Specialist to drive the growth of Bloomberg's MAC3 factor risk model datasets in the UK. This is a new-business sales role with accountability for developing a qualified pipeline, acquiring new clients, expanding strategic relationships, and delivering against annual revenue goals.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analytics, portfolio construction, and enterprise technology. You will partner with some of the world's largest and most sophisticated investment firms.

Acting as a trusted advisor throughout the sales lifecycle, you will lead technical and commercial engagements, uncover client requirements, understand portfolio risk, construction, and optimization workflows, and demonstrate how Bloomberg's MAC3 risk model can address complex investment and enterprise data needs.

You will manage opportunities from initial discovery and qualification through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, and close. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Account Management, Legal, and Implementation teams globally, serving as both a market-facing sales specialist and a strategic voice for our clients. Your insights will directly influence product development and help shape the future direction of Bloomberg's risk solutions.

Lead Strategic Client Engagements - Develop relationships with CROs, senior risk managers, quantitative teams, portfolio managers, portfolio construction and optimization teams, model validation groups, data and technology teams, and operational stakeholders across leading buy-side institutions.

5+ years of experience selling institutional investment technology, risk analytics, portfolio management, factor model data, or other quantitative solutions.

Strong understanding of factor risk models and their application to risk estimation, portfolio construction, optimization, factor exposure management, and institutional investment decision-making.

Description & Requirements

About the Team

Bloomberg’s CTO Office is the future-looking technical and product arm of Bloomberg L.P. We envision, design, and prototype the next generation of infrastructure, hardware, and applications that power the Bloomberg Terminal and beyond. Our work spans AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, open-source stewardship, and generative AI innovation.

For over a decade, Bloomberg has been at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence, ML, and NLP to financial intelligence, powering products in sentiment analysis, classification, document understanding, recommendation, and generative AI. AI platforms succeed only when their users can easily discover, understand, compose, and operate their capabilities. You will play a pivotal role in shaping Bloomberg’s AI future by building the platform that enables product teams across all AI initiatives. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

We are Assembly, a leading global omnichannel media agency that merges data, talent, and technology to catalyze growth for the world's most esteemed brands. Our holistic approach weaves together compelling brand narratives with a comprehensive suite of global media capabilities, driving performance and fostering significant business expansion. Our initiatives are powered by STAGE, our proprietary operating system, and executed by a dedicated global team of over 3,000 professionals across 44 offices worldwide. Committed to purposeful action, we lead the way in social and environmental impact within the agency realm. As a proud member of Stagwell, the challenger network designed to revolutionize marketing, Assembly continues to set new standards of excellence.

ICYMI: Assembly was named Campaign’s 2025 Most Innovative Agency and Sustainability Standout and 2024 Media Agency of the Year. Our innovative work has also earned prestigious accolades, including The Webby Awards, Effies, and Cannes Lions.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram !

Overview

The Coordinator, Paid Search is an entry-level role focused on supporting campaign execution, building foundational SEM knowledge, and learning core agency processes. Working under close supervision, this role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely work across campaign setup, reporting, and operational support. The Coordinator develops hands-on experience in paid search platforms while contributing to team success through strong organization, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset.

Responsibilities

 Campaign Execution & Optimization Support 

 Assist in trafficking approved media plans and ensuring accurate campaign setup across paid search platforms  Support keyword research, ad copy development, and QA of campaign assets  Monitor campaign budgets, pacing, and bid adjustments under guidance from senior team members  Execute basic optimizations and campaign updates as directed 

 Reporting & Data Analysis 

 Pull, organize, and validate performance data to support reporting and optimization efforts  Assist in preparing client-facing reports and presentations, highlighting key trends and insights  Develop an understanding of campaign KPIs, tracking requirements, and performance metrics  Identify basic performance trends and escalate findings to the team 

 Billing & Financial Operations 

 Support monthly billing processes, maintaining records and assisting with reconciliation  Help identify and resolve billing discrepancies with internal teams  Assist with vendor documentation and purchase authorization processes 

 Research & Planning Support 

 Assist in gathering research and data to support campaign planning and development  Gain familiarity with client business objectives, products, and competitive landscape  Contribute to team brainstorms and strategic discussions 

 Team Collaboration & Operations 

 Collaborate with cross-functional team members on daily campaign operations  Provide clear, timely updates to internal teams on task progress and deliverables  Maintain organized documentation and track deliverables across campaigns 

 Learning & Development 

 Learn and begin using paid search platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) and bid management tools  Stay current on industry trends, tools, and ad formats through training and independent research  Complete required training programs and certifications to build foundational SEM knowledge 

Qualifications

 0–18 months of experience in marketing, advertising, analytics, or a related field (internships applicable)  Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel (e.g., formulas, pivot tables), PowerPoint, and Word  Familiarity with paid search platforms such as Google Ads and Microsoft Ads (training provided)  Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and identify trends  Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines  Clear written and verbal communication skills for internal collaboration and client support  Collaborative and receptive to feedback, with a strong team-oriented mindset  Accountable for delivering high-quality work on time  Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a willingness to learn and grow  Curious and open to new tools, platforms, and industry development 

Benefits

Why Assembly?

 We care about your growth – we offer competitive salaries and annual compensation reviews  We recognize and celebrate your success…all the time! Whether it’s through company meetups, employee recognition programs, or just a regular day, we make sure our people’s achievements are known and appreciated  We’re truly a people-first organization. That’s why we offer a Flexible Time Off policy that puts you in control of your work-life balance, as well as market-leading primary and secondary caregiver and parental leave policies  We have a hybrid in-office/remote working policy that focuses on bringing people together in-person when it’s needed most, i.e., team strategy brainstorms, learning & development opportunities, and company meetings  We care about social and environmental Impact – we have dedicated Impact Champions who collaborate globally to make sure we’re leaving the world better than we found it  We have an amazing group of Employee Resource Groups who form close knit communities and are committed to guiding the agency to become more inclusive, diverse, and representative of the world around us  We’re part of Stagwell, the challenger network built to transform marketing. We’re nimble and digital-first, and we’re quickly growing to take on the biggest legacy hold cos 

 Equal Opportunities 

At Assembly, we believe every career is as unique as the individual and empower employees to reach their full potential in a winning culture motivated by a powerful purpose.

We are committed to ensuring equal opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
